602: function subjectNameMap(manifest: PrevisProductionManifestV1): Record<string, string> {
603:   const map: Record<string, string> = {};
604:   for (const character of manifest.cast) map[character.id] = character.name;
605:   for (const prop of manifest.props ?? []) map[prop.id] = prop.name;
606:   return map;
607: }
608: 
609: function resolveMappingIds(
610:   mapping: PrevisEntityMapping,
611:   createdRefs?: Record<string, { id: string; ref?: string; kind: string; name: string }>,
612: ): PrevisEntityMapping {
613:   if (!createdRefs) return mapping;
614:   const next: PrevisEntityMapping = { ...mapping };
615:   if (mapping.objectId && createdRefs[mapping.objectId]) {
616:     next.objectId = createdRefs[mapping.objectId]!.id;
617:   }
618:   if (mapping.objectIds) {
619:     next.objectIds = mapping.objectIds.map((token) => createdRefs[token]?.id ?? token);
620:   }
621:   if (mapping.anchors) {
622:     next.anchors = Object.fromEntries(
623:       Object.entries(mapping.anchors).map(([key, token]) => [
624:         key,
625:         createdRefs[token]?.id ?? token,
626:       ]),
627:     );
628:   }
629:   if (mapping.refs) {
630:     next.refs = Object.fromEntries(
631:       Object.entries(mapping.refs).map(([key, token]) => [
632:         key,
633:         createdRefs[token]?.id ?? token,
634:       ]),
635:     );
636:   }
637:   return next;
638: }
639: 
640: export async function runPrevisCli(options: PrevisCliOptions): Promise<PrevisCliResult> {
641:   const runStartedAt = Date.now();
642:   const outputDir = path.resolve(options.outputDir);
643:   const mode = options.mode ?? 'previs';
644:   const renderProfile = options.renderProfile ?? resolveRenderProfileForMode(mode);
645:   const renderProfileFingerprintValue = options.renderProfileFingerprint
646:     ?? renderProfileFingerprint(renderProfile);
647:   const runId = options.runId ?? `previs_${Date.now().toString(36)}`;
648:   const autoRepair = options.autoRepair ?? true;
649:   const maxRepairPasses = options.maxRepairPasses ?? 3;
650:   const skipControlVideos = options.skipControlVideos ?? !renderProfile.renderVideo;
651:   const skipPackage = options.skipPackage ?? renderProfile.skipPackage;
652:   const timeBudget = options.timeBudgetSeconds
653:     ? new ProductionTimeBudget(options.timeBudgetSeconds, runStartedAt)
654:     : undefined;
655:   const timing = emptyProductionTiming();
656:   let sourceRevisionId: string | undefined;
657:   let resultRevisionId: string | undefined;
658:   let repairMs = 0;
659: 
660:   await mkdir(outputDir, { recursive: true });
661:   await mkdir(path.join(outputDir, 'logs'), { recursive: true });
662:   await mkdir(path.join(outputDir, 'shots'), { recursive: true });
663:   await mkdir(path.join(outputDir, 'debug'), { recursive: true });
664: 
665:   const rawManifest = await readFile(path.resolve(options.manifestPath), 'utf8');
666:   const validationStartedAt = Date.now();
667:   const parsed = parsePrevisProductionManifest(JSON.parse(rawManifest) as unknown);
668:   timing.validationMs = Date.now() - validationStartedAt;
669:   if (!parsed.manifest || parsed.errors.length > 0) {
670:     return {
671:       ok: false,
672:       phase: 'validate',
673:       diagnostics: parsed.errors,
674:       error: 'Manifest validation failed.',
675:     };
676:   }
677: 
678:   const manifest = parsed.manifest;
679:   const consentToken = options.allowHeavyCharacterImports
680:     ? 'agent:previs:allow-heavy-character-imports'
681:     : undefined;
682:   const manifestHash = hashPrevisManifest(manifest);
683:   const importedCharacterCount = manifest.cast.filter((character) => character.type === 'imported_character').length;
684:   const characterAssets: ResolvedManifestCharacterAsset[] = [];
685: 
686:   for (const character of manifest.cast) {
687:     if (character.type !== 'imported_character') continue;
688:     const sourcePath = manifestCharacterSourcePath(options.manifestPath, character.source);
689:     try {
690:       const info = await stat(sourcePath);
691:       if (!info.isFile()) throw new Error('source is not a file');
692:     } catch {
693:       return {
694:         ok: false,
695:         phase: 'validate',
696:         diagnostics: [{
697:           code: 'missing_imported_character_source',
698:           path: `cast[id=${character.id}].source`,
699:           message: `Imported character source was not found: ${sourcePath}`,
700:           severity: 'error',
701:         }],
702:         error: 'Manifest validation failed.',
703:       };
704:     }
705:     if (character.rigPackage) {
706:       const rigPackagePath = manifestCharacterSourcePath(options.manifestPath, character.rigPackage);
707:       try {
708:         const info = await stat(rigPackagePath);
709:         if (!info.isFile()) throw new Error('rigPackage is not a file');
710:       } catch {
711:         return {
712:           ok: false,
713:           phase: 'validate',
714:           diagnostics: [{
715:             code: 'missing_saved_rig_package',
716:             path: `cast[id=${character.id}].rigPackage`,
717:             message: `Saved rig package was not found: ${rigPackagePath}`,
718:             severity: 'error',
719:           }],
720:           error: 'Manifest validation failed.',
721:         };
722:       }
723:     }
724:     try {
725:       characterAssets.push(await resolveManifestCharacterAsset(options.manifestPath, character));
726:     } catch (error) {
727:       return {
728:         ok: false,
729:         phase: 'validate',
730:         diagnostics: [{
731:           code: 'character_asset_hash_failed',
732:           path: `cast[id=${character.id}]`,
733:           message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : `Could not hash imported character "${character.id}".`,
734:           severity: 'error',
735:         }],
736:         error: 'Manifest validation failed.',
737:       };
738:     }
739:   }
740: 
741:   const loaded = await loadOrCreateRunState({
742:     outputDir,
743:     manifest,
744:     manifestHash,
745:     updateManifest: options.updateManifest,
746:   });
747:   let state = loaded.state;
748:   const profileMigration = migrateRenderProfileChange(state, renderProfileFingerprintValue);
749:   state = profileMigration.state;
750:   state = {
751:     ...state,
752:     runId,
753:     mode,
754:     renderProfileId: renderProfile.id,
755:     renderProfileFingerprint: renderProfileFingerprintValue,
756:   };
757:   const runStatePath = path.join(outputDir, 'run-state.json');
758: 
759:   if (loaded.error && loaded.resumed && !loaded.updated) {
760:     // Keep the previous manifest.normalized.json intact for a later --update-manifest.
761:     await writeJson(runStatePath, state);
762:     return {
763:       ok: false,
764:       phase: 'initialized',
765:       manifestHash,
766:       runStatePath,
767:       error: loaded.error,
768:     };
769:   }
770: 
771:   if (loaded.sceneRebuildRequired && !options.resetProject) {
772:     return {
773:       ok: false,
774:       phase: 'initialized',
775:       manifestHash,
776:       runStatePath,
777:       error:
778:         'Manifest update changed locations, cast, or props. Re-run with --update-manifest --reset-project so the scene can be rebuilt without duplicate creates. Shot-only edits do not need --reset-project.',
779:     };
780:   }
781: 
782:   const staleImportedCharacters = characterAssets.filter((asset) => {
783:     const mapping = state.entities[`cast.${asset.id}`];
784:     return Boolean(mapping?.objectId && mapping.importFingerprint !== asset.importFingerprint);
785:   });
786:   if (staleImportedCharacters.length > 0 && !(options.updateManifest && options.resetProject)) {
787:     const first = staleImportedCharacters[0]!;
788:     return {
789:       ok: false,
790:       phase: 'initialized',
791:       manifestHash,
792:       runStatePath,
793:       error:
794:         `Imported character "${first.id}" changed since the previous run. `
795:         + 'Run with --update-manifest --reset-project to rebuild cast-dependent shots.',
796:     };
797:   }
798: 
799:   await writeJson(path.join(outputDir, 'manifest.normalized.json'), manifest);
800: 
801:   if (loaded.updated) {
802:     await writeJson(path.join(outputDir, 'logs', 'manifest-update.json'), {
803:       nextHash: manifestHash,
804:       note: 'Applied controlled --update-manifest invalidation.',
805:       sceneRebuildRequired: Boolean(loaded.sceneRebuildRequired),
806:     });
807:     await writeJson(runStatePath, state);
808:   }
809: 
810:   if (options.resetProject && !options.writeAccess) {
811:     return {
812:       ok: false,
813:       error: '--reset-project requires --write (or --persist-write).',
814:     };
815:   }
816: 
817:   const session = await openAgentBrowser({
818:     url: options.url,
819:     headless: options.headless,
820:     writeAccess: options.writeAccess,
821:     persistWrite: options.persistWrite,
822:     profileDir: options.profileDir,
823:   });
824: 
825:   let framesRendered = 0;
826:   let cacheHits = 0;
827:   let cacheMisses = 0;
828:   let controlVideosRendered = 0;
829:   let controlVideosFailed = 0;
830: 
831:   try {
832:     timeBudget?.assertWithinBudget('open_package');
833:     await waitForAgentIdle(session.page);
834:     const status = await session.page.evaluate(() => window.foreScene!.getStatus());
835:     sourceRevisionId = status.revisionId;
836: 
837:     const compilationStartedAt = Date.now();
838:     const savedRigPreflight = [] as Array<{
839:       id: string;
840:       source: string;
841:       rigPackage: string;
842:       sourceSha256: string;
843:       rigPackageSha256?: string;
844:       ok: boolean;
845:       analysis?: unknown;
846:       diagnostics?: unknown[];
847:     }>;
848:     for (const character of manifest.cast) {
849:       if (character.type !== 'imported_character' || character.rigMode !== 'saved-rig') continue;
850:       const asset = characterAssets.find((candidate) => candidate.id === character.id);
851:       if (!asset?.rigPackagePath) continue;
852:       try {
853:         const analysis = await analyzeManifestSavedRigCharacter(session.page, asset, character);
854:         const diagnostics = [...analysis.diagnostics];
855:         if (analysis.sourceImportRequiresConsent && !consentToken) {
856:           diagnostics.push({
857:             code: 'invalid_argument',
858:             message: 'This character import requires explicit consent because it exceeds the standard memory tier.',
859:             severity: 'error',
860:           });
861:         }
862:         savedRigPreflight.push({
863:           id: character.id,
864:           source: character.source,
865:           rigPackage: character.rigPackage!,
866:           sourceSha256: asset.sourceSha256,
867:           ...(asset.rigPackageSha256 ? { rigPackageSha256: asset.rigPackageSha256 } : {}),
868:           ok: analysis.ok && diagnostics.length === 0,
869:           analysis,
870:           diagnostics,
871:         });
872:       } catch (error) {
873:         savedRigPreflight.push({
874:           id: character.id,
875:           source: character.source,
876:           rigPackage: character.rigPackage!,
877:           sourceSha256: asset.sourceSha256,
878:           ...(asset.rigPackageSha256 ? { rigPackageSha256: asset.rigPackageSha256 } : {}),
879:           ok: false,
880:           diagnostics: [{
881:             code: 'saved_rig_preflight_failed',
882:             message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
883:             severity: 'error',
884:           }],
885:         });
886:       }
887:     }
888:     if (savedRigPreflight.length > 0) {
889:       await writeJson(path.join(outputDir, 'logs', 'saved-rig-preflight.json'), {
890:         ok: savedRigPreflight.every((entry) => entry.ok),
891:         entries: savedRigPreflight,
892:       });
893:     }
894:     const failedSavedRig = savedRigPreflight.filter((entry) => !entry.ok);
895:     if (failedSavedRig.length > 0) {
896:       return {
897:         ok: false,
898:         phase: 'saved-rig-preflight',
899:         projectId: state.projectId,
900:         manifestHash,
901:         runStatePath,
902:         diagnostics: failedSavedRig.flatMap((entry) => entry.diagnostics ?? []),
903:         error: 'Saved-rig compatibility preflight failed; project reset was skipped.',
904:       };
905:     }
906: 
907:     if (options.resetProject) {
908:       const reset = await resetProjectOnPage(session.page, {
909:         name: manifest.project.name,
910:         description: manifest.project.description,
911:         aspectRatio: manifest.project.aspectRatio,
912:         frameRate: manifest.project.frameRate,
913:       });
914:       await writeJson(path.join(outputDir, 'logs', 'initialize.json'), { reset, status });
915:       if (!reset.ok) {
916:         return {
917:           ok: false,
918:           phase: 'initialized',
919:           manifestHash,
920:           runStatePath,
921:           diagnostics: reset.diagnostics,
922:           error: 'Project reset failed.',
923:         };
924:       }
925:       // After a controlled update + reset, keep completed frames for shots that
926:       // were not invalidated; staging must be recompiled into the blank project.
927:       const priorShots = loaded.updated ? state.shots : undefined;
928:       state = createInitialRunState({
929:         manifestHash,
930:         outputDir,
931:         projectId: reset.projectId,
932:         shotNumbers: manifest.shots.map((shot) => shot.shotNumber),
933:       });
934:       if (priorShots) {
935:         for (const [shotNumber, prior] of Object.entries(priorShots)) {
936:           const keepFrame = (
937:             prior.compile === 'complete'
938:             && prior.render === 'complete'
939:             && Boolean(prior.framePath)
940:           );
941:           state = upsertShotState(state, shotNumber, {
942:             compile: 'pending',
943:             render: keepFrame ? 'complete' : 'pending',
944:             validation: keepFrame ? prior.validation : 'pending',
945:             framePath: keepFrame ? prior.framePath : undefined,
946:             issues: keepFrame ? prior.issues : undefined,
947:             renderAttempts: keepFrame ? (prior.renderAttempts ?? prior.attempts ?? 0) : 0,
948:             repairAttempts: 0,
949:             attempts: 0,
950:           });
951:         }
952:       }
953:       state = setPhase(state, 'initialized', 'complete');
954:       state.revisionId = reset.verifiedRevisionId;
955:       state.projectId = reset.projectId;
956:     } else if (state.phases.initialized !== 'complete') {
957:       state = setPhase(state, 'initialized', 'complete');
958:       state.projectId = status.projectId;
959:       state.revisionId = status.revisionId;
960:     } else if (!state.projectId) {
961:       state.projectId = status.projectId;
962:     }
963: 
964:     await writeJson(runStatePath, state);
965: 
966:     if (options.initializeOnly) {
967:       return {
968:         ok: true,
969:         phase: 'initialized',
970:         projectId: state.projectId,
971:         manifestHash,
972:         runStatePath,
973:       };
974:     }
975: 
976:     if (!options.writeAccess) {
977:       return {
978:         ok: false,
979:         phase: firstIncompletePhase(state) ?? 'locations',
980:         projectId: state.projectId,
981:         manifestHash,
982:         runStatePath,
983:         error: 'Full previs orchestration requires --write.',
984:       };
985:     }
986: 
987:     const skipShots = new Set(
988:       Object.entries(state.shots)
989:         .filter(([, shot]) => shot.compile === 'complete')
990:         .map(([shotNumber]) => shotNumber),
991:     );
992: 
993:     const compiled = compileProduction(manifest, { skipShotNumbers: skipShots });
994:     await writeJson(path.join(outputDir, 'logs', 'compile.json'), {
995:       ok: compiled.ok,
996:       diagnostics: compiled.diagnostics,
997:       locationCommands: compiled.locations.plan.commands.length,
998:       castCommands: compiled.cast.plan.commands.length,
999:       propCommands: compiled.props.plan.commands.length,
1000:       shotBatches: compiled.shotBatches.length,
1001:     });
1002: 
1003:     if (state.phases.locations !== 'complete' && compiled.locations.plan.commands.length > 0) {
1004:       state = setPhase(state, 'locations', 'in_progress');
1005:       const applied = await applyPlanOnPage(session.page, compiled.locations.plan);
1006:       await writeJson(path.join(outputDir, 'logs', 'scene-locations.json'), applied);
1007:       if (!applied.ok) {
1008:         state = setPhase(state, 'locations', 'failed');
1009:         await writeJson(runStatePath, state);
1010:         return {
1011:           ok: false,
1012:           phase: 'locations',
1013:           projectId: state.projectId,
1014:           manifestHash,
1015:           runStatePath,
1016:           diagnostics: applied.diagnostics,
1017:           error: 'Location apply failed.',
1018:         };
1019:       }
1020:       for (const [key, mapping] of Object.entries(compiled.context.entities)) {
1021:         if (key.startsWith('locations.')) {
1022:           state = upsertEntity(state, key, resolveMappingIds(mapping, applied.summary?.createdRefs));
1023:         }
1024:       }
1025:       state = setPhase(state, 'locations', 'complete');
1026:       await writeJson(runStatePath, state);
1027:     } else if (state.phases.locations !== 'complete') {
1028:       state = setPhase(state, 'locations', 'complete');
1029:     }
1030: 
1031:     if (state.phases.cast !== 'complete') {
1032:       const castCompilation = compileCastPhaseWithPersistedEntities(
1033:         manifest,
1034:         compiled.context,
1035:         state.entities,
1036:       );
1037:       state = setPhase(state, 'cast', 'in_progress');
1038:       let applied: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof applyPlanOnPage>> | undefined;
1039:       if (castCompilation.plan.commands.length > 0) {
1040:         applied = await applyPlanOnPage(session.page, castCompilation.plan);
1041:         if (!applied.ok) {
1042:           state = setPhase(state, 'cast', 'failed');
1043:           await writeJson(path.join(outputDir, 'logs', 'scene-cast.json'), {
1044:             applied,
1045:             importedCharacters: [],
1046:           });
1047:           await writeJson(runStatePath, state);
1048:           return {
1049:             ok: false,
1050:             phase: 'cast',
1051:             projectId: state.projectId,
1052:             manifestHash,
1053:             runStatePath,
1054:             diagnostics: applied.diagnostics,
1055:             error: 'Cast apply failed.',
1056:           };
1057:         }
1058:         for (const [key, mapping] of Object.entries(castCompilation.context.entities)) {
1059:           if (key.startsWith('cast.') && mapping.objectId) {
1060:             state = upsertEntity(state, key, resolveMappingIds(mapping, applied.summary?.createdRefs));
1061:           }
1062:         }
1063:       }
1064: 
1065:       const importedResults: Array<{
1066:         id: string;
1067:         source: string;
1068:         rigPackage?: string;
1069:         rigMode: string;
1070:         ok: boolean;
1071:         analysis?: unknown;
1072:         objectId?: string;
1073:         reused?: boolean;
1074:         appliedSavedRig?: boolean;
1075:         topologyVerified?: boolean;
1076:         sourceSha256?: string;
1077:         rigPackageSha256?: string;
1078:         warnings?: string[];
1079:         diagnostics?: unknown[];
1080:       }> = [];
1081:       for (const entry of castCompilation.importedCharacters ?? []) {
1082:         const asset = characterAssets.find((candidate) => candidate.id === entry.character.id);
1083:         const existingObjectId = state.entities[entry.entityKey]?.objectId;
1084:         if (existingObjectId) {
1085:           importedResults.push({
1086:             id: entry.character.id,
1087:             source: entry.character.source,
1088:             ...(entry.character.rigPackage ? { rigPackage: entry.character.rigPackage } : {}),
1089:             rigMode: entry.character.rigMode,
1090:             ok: true,
1091:             objectId: existingObjectId,
1092:             reused: true,
1093:             appliedSavedRig: state.entities[entry.entityKey]?.appliedSavedRig,
1094:             topologyVerified: state.entities[entry.entityKey]?.topologyVerified,
1095:             sourceSha256: asset?.sourceSha256,
1096:             rigPackageSha256: asset?.rigPackageSha256,
1097:           });
1098:           continue;
1099:         }

188:     const path = `locations[${index}]`;
189:     if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object' || Array.isArray(entry)) {
190:       errors.push(previsError(PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidType, 'location must be an object.', { path }));
191:       return;
192:     }
193:     const record = entry as Record<string, unknown>;
194:     const id = readId(record.id, `${path}.id`, locationIds, errors);
195:     const name = readNonemptyString(record.name, `${path}.name`, errors);
196:     const description = readOptionalString(record.description, `${path}.description`, errors, warnings);
197:     const template = readEnum(
198:       record.template,
199:       PREVIS_LOCATION_TEMPLATES,
200:       `${path}.template`,
201:       errors,
202:     ) as PrevisLocationTemplate | undefined;
203: 
204:     if (template === 'custom_blueprint') {
205:       errors.push(previsError(
206:         PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.customBlueprintUnsupported,
207:         'custom_blueprint is reserved for a later milestone; use a built-in template.',
208:         { path: `${path}.template`, entityId: id },
209:       ));
210:     }
211: 
212:     let dimensions: PrevisLocationDefinition['dimensions'];
213:     if (record.dimensions !== undefined) {
214:       if (!record.dimensions || typeof record.dimensions !== 'object' || Array.isArray(record.dimensions)) {
215:         errors.push(previsError(
216:           PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidType,
217:           'dimensions must be an object.',
218:           { path: `${path}.dimensions` },
219:         ));
220:       } else {
221:         const dim = record.dimensions as Record<string, unknown>;
222:         dimensions = {};
223:         const width = readOptionalPositiveNumber(dim.width, `${path}.dimensions.width`, errors);
224:         const depth = readOptionalPositiveNumber(dim.depth, `${path}.dimensions.depth`, errors);
225:         const height = readOptionalPositiveNumber(dim.height, `${path}.dimensions.height`, errors);
226:         if (width !== undefined) dimensions.width = width;
227:         if (depth !== undefined) dimensions.depth = depth;
228:         if (height !== undefined) dimensions.height = height;
229:       }
230:     }
231: 
232:     let features: PrevisLocationDefinition['features'];
233:     if (record.features !== undefined) {
234:       if (!Array.isArray(record.features)) {
235:         errors.push(previsError(
236:           PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidType,
237:           'features must be an array.',
238:           { path: `${path}.features` },
239:         ));
240:       } else if (record.features.length > PREVIS_MANIFEST_LIMITS.maxFeaturesPerLocation) {
241:         errors.push(previsError(
242:           PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.limitExceeded,
243:           `features exceeds ${PREVIS_MANIFEST_LIMITS.maxFeaturesPerLocation}.`,
244:           { path: `${path}.features` },
245:         ));
246:       } else {
247:         features = [];
248:         record.features.forEach((feature, featureIndex) => {
249:           const featurePath = `${path}.features[${featureIndex}]`;
250:           if (!feature || typeof feature !== 'object' || Array.isArray(feature)) {
251:             errors.push(previsError(
252:               PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidType,
253:               'feature must be an object.',
254:               { path: featurePath },
255:             ));
256:             return;
257:           }
258:           const featureRecord = feature as Record<string, unknown>;
259:           const type = readEnum(
260:             featureRecord.type,
261:             PREVIS_LOCATION_FEATURE_TYPES,
262:             `${featurePath}.type`,
263:             errors,
264:           ) as PrevisLocationFeatureType | undefined;
265:           const featureName = readNonemptyString(featureRecord.name, `${featurePath}.name`, errors);
266:           const placement = readOptionalString(
267:             featureRecord.placement,
268:             `${featurePath}.placement`,
269:             errors,
270:             warnings,
271:           );
272:           if (type && featureName) {
273:             features!.push({
274:               type,
275:               name: featureName,
276:               ...(placement !== undefined ? { placement } : {}),
277:             });
278:           }
279:         });
280:       }
281:     }
282: 
283:     if (id && name && template) {
284:       result.push({
285:         id,
286:         name,
287:         template,
288:         ...(description !== undefined ? { description } : {}),
289:         ...(dimensions !== undefined ? { dimensions } : {}),
290:         ...(features !== undefined ? { features } : {}),
291:       });
292:     }
293:   });
294: 
295:   return result;
296: }

298: function parseCast(
299:   value: unknown,
300:   castIds: Set<string>,
301:   errors: PrevisDiagnostic[],
302:   warnings: PrevisDiagnostic[],
303: ): PrevisCharacterDefinition[] {
304:   if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
305:     errors.push(previsError(
306:       PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.missingField,
307:       'cast must be an array.',
308:       { path: 'cast' },
309:     ));
310:     return [];
311:   }
312:   if (value.length === 0) {
313:     errors.push(previsError(
314:       PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.emptyField,
315:       'cast must contain at least one character.',
316:       { path: 'cast' },
317:     ));
318:     return [];
319:   }
320:   if (value.length > PREVIS_MANIFEST_LIMITS.maxCast) {
321:     errors.push(previsError(
322:       PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.limitExceeded,
323:       `cast exceeds the maximum of ${PREVIS_MANIFEST_LIMITS.maxCast}.`,
324:       { path: 'cast' },
325:     ));
326:   }
327: 
328:   const result: PrevisCharacterDefinition[] = [];
329:   value.forEach((entry, index) => {
330:     const path = `cast[${index}]`;
331:     if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object' || Array.isArray(entry)) {
332:       errors.push(previsError(PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidType, 'character must be an object.', { path }));
333:       return;
334:     }
335:     const record = entry as Record<string, unknown>;
336:     const id = readId(record.id, `${path}.id`, castIds, errors);
337:     const type = record.type;
338:     if (type !== 'human_dummy' && type !== 'imported_character') {
339:       errors.push(previsError(
340:         PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.unsupportedValue,
341:         'character.type must be "human_dummy" or "imported_character".',
342:         { path: `${path}.type`, entityId: id },
343:       ));
344:     }
345:     const name = record.name === undefined && type === 'imported_character'
346:       ? id
347:       : readNonemptyString(record.name, `${path}.name`, errors);
348:     let height: number | undefined;
349:     if (record.height !== undefined) {
350:       height = readOptionalPositiveNumber(record.height, `${path}.height`, errors);
351:       if (
352:         height !== undefined
353:         && (height < PREVIS_MANIFEST_LIMITS.minHeightMeters
354:           || height > PREVIS_MANIFEST_LIMITS.maxHeightMeters)
355:       ) {
356:         errors.push(previsError(
357:           PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidRange,
358:           `height must be between ${PREVIS_MANIFEST_LIMITS.minHeightMeters} and ${PREVIS_MANIFEST_LIMITS.maxHeightMeters}.`,
359:           { path: `${path}.height`, entityId: id },
360:         ));
361:         height = undefined;
362:       }
363:     }
364:     const color = readOptionalString(record.color, `${path}.color`, errors, warnings);
365:     const defaultPose = readOptionalString(record.defaultPose, `${path}.defaultPose`, errors, warnings);
366:     if (defaultPose && !isSupportedPrevisPosePreset(defaultPose)) {
367:       errors.push(previsError(
368:         PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.unsupportedValue,
369:         `Unknown defaultPose "${defaultPose}".`,
370:         { path: `${path}.defaultPose`, entityId: id },
371:       ));
372:     }
373: 
374:     if (type === 'imported_character') {
375:       const source = readNonemptyString(record.source, `${path}.source`, errors);
376:       const rigMode = readEnum(
377:         record.rigMode,
378:         PREVIS_IMPORTED_CHARACTER_RIG_MODES,
379:         `${path}.rigMode`,
380:         errors,
381:       ) as PrevisImportedCharacterRigMode | undefined;
382:       if (source && !/\.(?:glb|gltf|fbx)$/i.test(source)) {
383:         errors.push(previsError(
384:           PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.unsupportedValue,
385:           'source must point to a GLB, embedded glTF, or FBX file.',
386:           { path: `${path}.source`, entityId: id },
387:         ));
388:       }
389:       if (!source) {
390:         errors.push(previsError(
391:           PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.missingImportedCharacterSource,
392:           'Imported characters require an explicit model source path.',
393:           { path: `${path}.source`, entityId: id },
394:         ));
395:       }
396:       const rigPackage = readOptionalString(
397:         record.rigPackage,
398:         `${path}.rigPackage`,
399:         errors,
400:         warnings,
401:       );
402:       if (rigMode === 'saved-rig') {
403:         if (!rigPackage) {
404:           errors.push(previsError(
405:             PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.missingSavedRigPackage,
406:             'rigPackage is required when rigMode is "saved-rig".',
407:             { path: `${path}.rigPackage`, entityId: id },
408:           ));
409:         } else if (!/\.(?:fsrig|panorig)$/i.test(rigPackage) || /[\\/]\s*$/.test(rigPackage)) {
410:           errors.push(previsError(
411:             PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.unsupportedSavedRigExtension,
412:             'rigPackage must point to a .fsrig or legacy .panorig file.',
413:             { path: `${path}.rigPackage`, entityId: id },
414:           ));
415:         }
416:       } else if (rigPackage !== undefined) {
417:         errors.push(previsError(
418:           PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.unexpectedRigPackage,
419:           'rigPackage is only allowed when rigMode is "saved-rig".',
420:           { path: `${path}.rigPackage`, entityId: id },
421:         ));
422:       }
423:       if (id && name && source && rigMode) {
424:         result.push({
425:           id,
426:           name,
427:           type: 'imported_character',
428:           source,
429:           rigMode,
430:           ...(rigPackage !== undefined ? { rigPackage } : {}),
431:           ...(height !== undefined ? { height } : {}),
432:           ...(defaultPose !== undefined ? { defaultPose } : {}),
433:         });
434:       }
435:     } else if (id && name && type === 'human_dummy') {
436:       result.push({
437:         id,
438:         name,
439:         type: 'human_dummy',
440:         ...(height !== undefined ? { height } : {}),
441:         ...(color !== undefined ? { color } : {}),
442:         ...(defaultPose !== undefined ? { defaultPose } : {}),
443:       });
444:     }
445:   });
446: 
447:   return result;
448: }

450: function parseProps(
451:   value: unknown,
452:   propIds: Set<string>,
453:   errors: PrevisDiagnostic[],
454:   warnings: PrevisDiagnostic[],
455: ): PrevisPropDefinition[] {
456:   if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
457:     errors.push(previsError(
458:       PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidType,
459:       'props must be an array when provided.',
460:       { path: 'props' },
461:     ));
462:     return [];
463:   }
464:   if (value.length > PREVIS_MANIFEST_LIMITS.maxProps) {
465:     errors.push(previsError(
466:       PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.limitExceeded,
467:       `props exceeds the maximum of ${PREVIS_MANIFEST_LIMITS.maxProps}.`,
468:       { path: 'props' },
469:     ));
470:   }
471: 
472:   const result: PrevisPropDefinition[] = [];
473:   value.forEach((entry, index) => {
474:     const path = `props[${index}]`;
475:     if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object' || Array.isArray(entry)) {
476:       errors.push(previsError(PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidType, 'prop must be an object.', { path }));
477:       return;
478:     }
479:     const record = entry as Record<string, unknown>;
480:     const id = readId(record.id, `${path}.id`, propIds, errors);
481:     const name = readNonemptyString(record.name, `${path}.name`, errors);
482:     const primitive = readEnum(
483:       record.primitive,
484:       PREVIS_PROP_PRIMITIVES,
485:       `${path}.primitive`,
486:       errors,
487:     ) as PrevisPropPrimitive | undefined;
488:     let dimensions: [number, number, number] | undefined;
489:     if (record.dimensions !== undefined) {
490:       dimensions = readVec3(record.dimensions, `${path}.dimensions`, errors);
491:     }
492:     const color = readOptionalString(record.color, `${path}.color`, errors, warnings);
493: 
494:     if (id && name && primitive) {
495:       result.push({
496:         id,
497:         name,
498:         primitive,
499:         ...(dimensions ? { dimensions } : {}),
500:         ...(color !== undefined ? { color } : {}),
501:       });
502:     }
503:   });
504: 
505:   return result;
506: }

508: function parseShots(
509:   value: unknown,
510:   ids: {
511:     locationIds: Set<string>;
512:     castIds: Set<string>;
513:     propIds: Set<string>;
514:     shotIds: Set<string>;
515:     shotNumbers: Set<string>;
516:   },
517:   errors: PrevisDiagnostic[],
518:   warnings: PrevisDiagnostic[],
519: ): PrevisShotDefinition[] {
520:   if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
521:     errors.push(previsError(
522:       PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.missingField,
523:       'shots must be an array.',
524:       { path: 'shots' },
525:     ));
526:     return [];
527:   }
528:   if (value.length === 0) {
529:     errors.push(previsError(
530:       PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.emptyField,
531:       'shots must contain at least one shot.',
532:       { path: 'shots' },
533:     ));
534:     return [];
535:   }
536:   if (value.length > PREVIS_MANIFEST_LIMITS.maxShots) {
537:     errors.push(previsError(
538:       PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.limitExceeded,
539:       `shots exceeds the maximum of ${PREVIS_MANIFEST_LIMITS.maxShots}.`,
540:       { path: 'shots' },
541:     ));
542:   }
543: 
544:   const result: PrevisShotDefinition[] = [];
545:   value.forEach((entry, index) => {
546:     const path = `shots[${index}]`;
547:     if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object' || Array.isArray(entry)) {
548:       errors.push(previsError(PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidType, 'shot must be an object.', { path }));
549:       return;
550:     }
551:     const record = entry as Record<string, unknown>;
552:     const id = readId(record.id, `${path}.id`, ids.shotIds, errors);
553:     const shotNumber = readNonemptyString(record.shotNumber, `${path}.shotNumber`, errors);
554:     if (shotNumber) {
555:       if (ids.shotNumbers.has(shotNumber)) {
556:         errors.push(previsError(
557:           PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.duplicateShotNumber,
558:           `Duplicate shotNumber "${shotNumber}".`,
559:           { path: `${path}.shotNumber`, entityId: id },
560:         ));
561:       } else {
562:         ids.shotNumbers.add(shotNumber);
563:       }
564:     }
565:     const name = readNonemptyString(record.name, `${path}.name`, errors);
566:     const description = readOptionalString(record.description, `${path}.description`, errors, warnings) ?? '';
567:     if (record.description === undefined) {
568:       errors.push(previsError(
569:         PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.missingField,
570:         'description is required.',
571:         { path: `${path}.description`, entityId: id },
572:       ));
573:     }
574:     const locationId = readNonemptyString(record.locationId, `${path}.locationId`, errors);
575:     if (locationId && !ids.locationIds.has(locationId)) {
576:       errors.push(previsError(
577:         PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.unknownReference,
578:         `Unknown locationId "${locationId}".`,
579:         { path: `${path}.locationId`, entityId: id },
580:       ));
581:     }
582: 
583:     const subjects = parseStringArray(record.subjects, `${path}.subjects`, errors, true);
584:     for (const subject of subjects) {
585:       if (!ids.castIds.has(subject) && !ids.propIds.has(subject)) {
586:         errors.push(previsError(
587:           PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.unknownReference,
588:           `Unknown subject "${subject}" (not in cast or props).`,
589:           { path: `${path}.subjects`, entityId: id },
590:         ));
591:       }
592:     }
593: 
594:     const blocking = record.blocking === undefined
595:       ? undefined
596:       : parseBlocking(record.blocking, `${path}.blocking`, ids, errors, warnings);
597: 
598:     const camera = parseCamera(record.camera, `${path}.camera`, ids, errors, warnings);
599: 
600:     let requirements: PrevisShotDefinition['requirements'];
601:     if (record.requirements !== undefined) {
602:       if (!record.requirements || typeof record.requirements !== 'object' || Array.isArray(record.requirements)) {
603:         errors.push(previsError(
604:           PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidType,
605:           'requirements must be an object.',
606:           { path: `${path}.requirements` },
607:         ));
608:       } else {
609:         const req = record.requirements as Record<string, unknown>;
610:         const visibleSubjects = req.visibleSubjects === undefined
611:           ? undefined
612:           : parseStringArray(req.visibleSubjects, `${path}.requirements.visibleSubjects`, errors, false);
613:         const visibleProps = req.visibleProps === undefined
614:           ? undefined
615:           : parseStringArray(req.visibleProps, `${path}.requirements.visibleProps`, errors, false);
616:         const notes = req.notes === undefined
617:           ? undefined
618:           : parseStringArray(req.notes, `${path}.requirements.notes`, errors, false);
619: 
620:         for (const subject of visibleSubjects ?? []) {
621:           if (!ids.castIds.has(subject)) {
622:             errors.push(previsError(
623:               PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.unknownReference,
624:               `Unknown visibleSubjects entry "${subject}".`,
625:               { path: `${path}.requirements.visibleSubjects`, entityId: id },
626:             ));
627:           }
628:         }
629:         for (const prop of visibleProps ?? []) {
630:           if (!ids.propIds.has(prop)) {
631:             errors.push(previsError(
632:               PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.unknownReference,
633:               `Unknown visibleProps entry "${prop}".`,
634:               { path: `${path}.requirements.visibleProps`, entityId: id },
635:             ));
636:           }
637:         }
638: 
639:         requirements = {
640:           ...(visibleSubjects ? { visibleSubjects } : {}),
641:           ...(visibleProps ? { visibleProps } : {}),
642:           ...(notes ? { notes } : {}),
643:         };
644:       }
645:     }
646: 
647:     const motion = record.motion === undefined
648:       ? undefined
649:       : parseShotMotion(record.motion, `${path}.motion`, ids, errors, warnings);
650: 
651:     if (id && shotNumber && name && locationId && camera) {
652:       result.push({
653:         id,
654:         shotNumber,
655:         name,
656:         description,
657:         locationId,
658:         subjects,
659:         camera,
660:         ...(blocking ? { blocking } : {}),
661:         ...(requirements ? { requirements } : {}),
662:         ...(motion ? { motion } : {}),
663:       });
664:     }
665:   });
666: 
667:   return result;
668: }
669: 
670: function parseShotMotion(
671:   value: unknown,
672:   path: string,
673:   ids: { castIds: Set<string>; propIds: Set<string> },
674:   errors: PrevisDiagnostic[],
675:   warnings: PrevisDiagnostic[],
676: ): PrevisShotMotion | undefined {
677:   if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {
678:     errors.push(previsError(PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidType, 'motion must be an object.', { path }));
679:     return undefined;
680:   }
681:   const record = value as Record<string, unknown>;
682:   const durationSeconds = readOptionalPositiveNumber(record.durationSeconds, `${path}.durationSeconds`, errors);
683:   const renderControlVideo = record.renderControlVideo === undefined
684:     ? undefined
685:     : Boolean(record.renderControlVideo);
686:   if (record.renderControlVideo !== undefined && typeof record.renderControlVideo !== 'boolean') {
687:     errors.push(previsError(PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidType, `${path}.renderControlVideo must be a boolean.`, { path: `${path}.renderControlVideo` }));
688:   }
689:   if (!Array.isArray(record.keyframes) || record.keyframes.length < 2) {
690:     errors.push(previsError(PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidRange, `${path}.keyframes must contain at least two entries.`, { path: `${path}.keyframes` }));
691:     return undefined;
692:   }
693:   const keyframes = record.keyframes.flatMap((entry, index) => {
694:     const itemPath = `${path}.keyframes[${index}]`;
695:     if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object' || Array.isArray(entry)) {
696:       errors.push(previsError(PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidType, 'motion keyframe must be an object.', { path: itemPath }));
697:       return [];
698:     }
699:     const item = entry as Record<string, unknown>;
700:     const timeSeconds = readNonnegativeNumber(item.timeSeconds, `${itemPath}.timeSeconds`, errors);
701:     let camera: PrevisShotMotionKeyframe['camera'] | undefined;
702:     if (item.camera !== undefined) {
703:       if (!item.camera || typeof item.camera !== 'object' || Array.isArray(item.camera)) {
704:         errors.push(previsError(PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidType, 'camera must be an object.', { path: `${itemPath}.camera` }));
705:       } else {
706:         const raw = item.camera as Record<string, unknown>;
707:         const position = raw.position === undefined ? undefined : readFiniteVec3(raw.position, `${itemPath}.camera.position`, errors);
708:         const target = raw.target === undefined ? undefined : readFiniteVec3(raw.target, `${itemPath}.camera.target`, errors);
709:         const fovDegrees = raw.fovDegrees === undefined ? undefined : readOptionalPositiveNumber(raw.fovDegrees, `${itemPath}.camera.fovDegrees`, errors);
710:         camera = { ...(position ? { position } : {}), ...(target ? { target } : {}), ...(fovDegrees !== undefined ? { fovDegrees } : {}) };
711:       }
712:     }
713:     const staging = parseMotionStaging(item.staging, `${itemPath}.staging`, ids, errors, warnings);
714:     return timeSeconds === undefined ? [] : [{ timeSeconds, ...(camera ? { camera } : {}), ...(staging ? { staging } : {}) }];
715:   });
716:   for (let index = 1; index < keyframes.length; index += 1) {
717:     if (keyframes[index]!.timeSeconds <= keyframes[index - 1]!.timeSeconds) {
718:       errors.push(previsError(PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidRange, 'motion keyframe times must be strictly increasing.', { path: `${path}.keyframes` }));
719:       break;
720:     }
721:   }
722:   if (durationSeconds === undefined) return undefined;
723:   if (keyframes.length < 2 || keyframes[keyframes.length - 1]!.timeSeconds !== durationSeconds) {
724:     errors.push(previsError(PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidRange, 'motion durationSeconds must equal the final keyframe time.', { path }));
725:     return undefined;
726:   }
727:   return { durationSeconds, ...(renderControlVideo !== undefined ? { renderControlVideo } : {}), keyframes };
728: }
729: 
730: function parseMotionStaging(
731:   value: unknown,
732:   path: string,
733:   ids: { castIds: Set<string>; propIds: Set<string> },
734:   errors: PrevisDiagnostic[],
735:   warnings: PrevisDiagnostic[],
736: ): PrevisShotMotionKeyframe['staging'] {
737:   if (value === undefined) return undefined;
738:   if (!Array.isArray(value)) {
739:     errors.push(previsError(PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidType, 'staging must be an array.', { path }));
740:     return undefined;
741:   }
742:   return value.flatMap((entry, index) => {
743:     const itemPath = `${path}[${index}]`;
744:     if (!entry || typeof entry !== 'object' || Array.isArray(entry)) {
745:       errors.push(previsError(PREVIS_DIAGNOSTIC_CODES.invalidType, 'staging entry must be an object.', { path: itemPath }));
746:       return [];
747:     }
748:     const item = entry as Record<string, unknown>;
749:     const subject = readNonemptyString(item.subject, `${itemPath}.subject`, errors);

48: function loadRuns(): void {

368:     const empty = await planAgentProductionCanary({ manifest: input.manifest, maxShots: input.maxCanaryShots });
369:     const gateState = inspectAgentProductionGates({ runId: empty.runId }).gateState;

399:   const state: AgentProductionRunState = {

434:   const state = getAgentProductionRun(runId);
435:   if (!state) return { ok: false, status: 'failed', runId, diagnostics: [agentError('production_run_not_found', `No production run "${runId}" exists.`)] };
436:   if (state.status === 'completed' || state.status === 'failed' || state.status === 'cancelled') return diagnosticsResult(state, [agentError('production_run_not_paused', 'A terminal production run cannot be paused.')]);
437:   const controller = runControllers.get(runId);

442: export async function resumeAgentProductionRun(runId: string): Promise<AgentProductionRunResult> {
443:   const state = getAgentProductionRun(runId);
444:   if (!state) return { ok: false, status: 'failed', runId, diagnostics: [agentError('production_run_not_found', `No production run "${runId}" exists.`)] };
445:   if (state.status === 'cancelled' || state.status === 'completed') return diagnosticsResult(state, [agentError('production_run_terminal', 'A terminal production run cannot be resumed.')]);
446:   if (state.status === 'paused') {
447:     // Allow resume from paused state.
448:   }
449:   const contextErrors = assertRunProjectContext(state);
450:   if (contextErrors.length > 0) return diagnosticsResult(state, contextErrors);
451:   if (!state.gateState.canaryApproved) {
452:     return diagnosticsResult(save({ ...state, status: 'needs_review' }), [agentError('canary_approval_required', 'Approve the capability canary before resuming the full still sequence.')]);
453:   }
454:   if (state.gateState.stillLayoutApproved) return diagnosticsResult(state, []);
455:   return runFullStillSequence(state);

458: export function cancelAgentProductionRun(runId: string): AgentProductionRunResult {
459:   const state = getAgentProductionRun(runId);
460:   if (!state) return { ok: false, status: 'failed', runId, diagnostics: [agentError('production_run_not_found', `No production run "${runId}" exists.`)] };
461:   markProductionRunCancelled(runId);
462:   const controller = runControllers.get(runId);
463:   const generation = (controller?.generation ?? 0) + 1;
464:   if (controller) {
465:     runControllers.set(runId, { generation, abort: controller.abort });
466:   }
467:   return diagnosticsResult(save({ ...state, status: 'cancelled', runGeneration: generation }), []);
468: }

470: export function subscribeAgentProductionRun(runId: string, listener: (state: AgentProductionRunState) => void): () => void {
471:   const set = listeners.get(runId) ?? new Set<(state: AgentProductionRunState) => void>();
472:   set.add(listener);
473:   listeners.set(runId, set);
474:   const current = getAgentProductionRun(runId);
475:   if (current) listener(current);
476:   return () => {
477:     set.delete(listener);
478:     if (set.size === 0) listeners.delete(runId);
479:   };
480: }

288: export async function runAgentProductionCanary(input: {
289:   runId: string;
290: }): Promise<AgentProductionCanaryRunResult> {
291:   const stored = getRun(input.runId);
292:   if (!stored) {
293:     return { ok: false, diagnostics: [agentError('production_run_not_found', `No production run "${input.runId}" exists.`)] };
294:   }
295:   const contextErrors = assertGateRunContext(stored);
296:   if (contextErrors.length > 0) {
297:     return { ok: false, runId: input.runId, diagnostics: contextErrors };
298:   }
299:   const plan = stored.gateState.canaryPlan;
300:   if (!plan) {
301:     return { ok: false, runId: input.runId, diagnostics: [agentError('canary_plan_missing', 'Plan the production canary before running it.')] };
302:   }
303:   const parsed = parsePrevisProductionManifest(stored.manifest);
304:   if (!parsed.manifest) {
305:     return { ok: false, runId: input.runId, diagnostics: [agentError('production_manifest_invalid', 'Production manifest is invalid.')] };
306:   }
307: 
308:   let gateState = startProductionGate(stored.gateState, 'AUTHOR_CANARY');
309:   runs.set(input.runId, { ...stored, gateState });
310:   persistRuns();
311: 
312:   const executed = await executeProductionCanary({
313:     runId: input.runId,
314:     plan,
315:     manifest: parsed.manifest,
316:     assertActive: () => {
317:       if (isProductionRunAborted(input.runId)) {
318:         throw new Error('Production canary run was cancelled.');
319:       }
320:       const latest = getRun(input.runId);
321:       if (!latest || latest.runGeneration !== stored.runGeneration) {
322:         throw new Error('Production canary run is stale.');
323:       }
324:       const errors = assertGateRunContext(latest);
325:       if (errors.length > 0) throw new Error(errors[0]!.message);
326:     },
327:   });
328: 
329:   gateState = completeProductionGate(gateState, 'AUTHOR_CANARY', {
330:     ok: executed.authorDiagnostics.length === 0,
331:     diagnostics: executed.authorDiagnostics,
332:   });
333:   gateState = completeProductionGate(gateState, 'VERIFY_CANARY_STATE', {
334:     ok: executed.verifyDiagnostics.length === 0 && executed.result.shotResults.every((item) => (
335:       item.presenceOk && item.capabilitiesOk && item.panoramaOk && item.compositionOk && !item.unrelatedStateChanged
336:     )),
337:     diagnostics: executed.verifyDiagnostics,
338:   });
339:   gateState = completeProductionGate(gateState, 'RENDER_CANARY', {
340:     ok: executed.renderDiagnostics.length === 0,
341:     diagnostics: executed.renderDiagnostics,
342:   });
343:   gateState = completeProductionGate(gateState, 'VERIFY_CANARY_OUTPUT', {
344:     ok: executed.result.ok,
345:     diagnostics: executed.result.diagnostics,
346:   });
347:   gateState = {
348:     ...gateState,
349:     canaryResult: executed.result,
350:     recoveryRevisionId: executed.recoveryRevisionId ?? gateState.recoveryRevisionId,
351:   };
352:   runs.set(input.runId, {
353:     ...stored,
354:     gateState,
355:     recoveryRevisionId: executed.recoveryRevisionId ?? stored.recoveryRevisionId,
356:   });
357:   persistRuns();
358:   const rollbackDiagnostics = executed.rollbackDiagnostics.map((item) => agentError(item.code, item.message));
359:   const gateOk = executed.result.ok && (!executed.rolledBack || executed.rollbackOk) && !executed.interrupted;
360:   return {
361:     ok: gateOk,
362:     runId: input.runId,
363:     result: executed.result,
364:     gateState,
365:     diagnostics: [
366:       ...executed.result.diagnostics.map((item) => agentError(item.code, item.message)),
367:       ...rollbackDiagnostics,
368:     ],
369:   };
370: }

317: export function validateProductionConfiguration(
318:   project: LocationProject,

344:         entityId: entity.id,

351:     if (binding.kind === 'object') {
352:       const object = objectById(project, binding.objectId);
353:       if (!object) {
354:         diagnostics.push(diagnostic('stale_object_id', `Binding for "${entity.id}" references missing object "${binding.objectId}".`, {
355:           entityId: entity.id,
356:           objectId: binding.objectId,
357:         }));
358:         continue;
359:       }
360:       if (!isRenderableProductionObject(project, object)) {
361:         diagnostics.push(diagnostic('bound_entity_not_renderable', `Binding for "${entity.id}" resolves to non-renderable object "${binding.objectId}".`, {
362:           entityId: entity.id,
363:           objectId: binding.objectId,
364:         }));

366:       for (const [groupId, group] of Object.entries(project.scene.objectGroups ?? {})) {
367:         if (group.objectIds.includes(object.id) && group.objectIds.length > 1) {
368:           diagnostics.push(diagnostic('partial_assembly', `Entity "${entity.id}" binds one member of multipart group "${groupId}" instead of the complete group.`, {

372:           }));
373:         }

377:           entityId: entity.id,

379:         }));
380:       }
381:     } else if (binding.kind === 'group') {
382:       const members = groupMembers(project, binding.groupId);
383:       if (!members.group) {
384:         diagnostics.push(diagnostic('stale_group_id', `Binding for "${entity.id}" references missing group "${binding.groupId}".`, {
385:           entityId: entity.id,
386:           groupId: binding.groupId,
387:         }));
388:       } else if (members.objectIds.length === 0) {
389:         diagnostics.push(diagnostic('empty_object_group', `Binding for "${entity.id}" references empty group "${binding.groupId}".`, {
390:           entityId: entity.id,
391:           groupId: binding.groupId,
392:         }));
393:       } else {
394:         for (const objectId of members.missingObjectIds) {
395:           diagnostics.push(diagnostic('partial_assembly', `Binding for "${entity.id}" is missing group member "${objectId}".`, {
396:             entityId: entity.id,
397:             groupId: binding.groupId,
398:             objectId,
399:           }));
400:         }
401:         if (groupHasPartialImportedAssembly(project, binding.groupId)) {
402:           diagnostics.push(diagnostic('partial_assembly', `Binding for "${entity.id}" references an incomplete imported assembly.`, {
403:             entityId: entity.id,

407:         if ((entity.kind === 'cast' || entity.kind === 'prop') && members.objectIds.some((objectId) => {
408:           const object = objectById(project, objectId);

410:         })) {

415:         }

417:     } else if (binding.kind === 'location') {
418:       const location = config.locations[binding.locationId];

427:         entityId: entity.id,

432:   for (const [target, owners] of targetOwners) {

105:   return Boolean(asset && !BAD_ASSET_STATUSES.has(asset.resolutionStatus ?? ''));
106: }

108: function requiredJointCoverage(joints: Iterable<HumanJointId>): {
109:   mappedJoints: HumanJointId[];
110:   missingRequiredJoints: HumanJointId[];
111: } {
112:   const mapped = new Set(joints);
113:   const missingRequiredJoints = REQUIRED_IMPORTED_HUMANOID_JOINTS.filter((jointId) => (
114:     !mapped.has(jointId) && !(jointId === 'spine' && mapped.has('chest'))
115:   ));
116:   return {
117:     mappedJoints: HUMAN_JOINT_IDS.filter((jointId) => mapped.has(jointId)),
118:     missingRequiredJoints,
119:   };
120: }

122: function usableAutorigSkin(project: LocationProject, skin: NonNullable<NonNullable<ReturnType<typeof resolvePoseableRigForObject>>['rig']['skin']>): boolean {
123:   if (skin.skinAssetId) return assetUsable(project, skin.skinAssetId);
124:   return Boolean(
125:     skin.indices && skin.weights
126:     && skin.indices.length > 0
127:     && skin.indices.length === skin.weights.length,
128:   );
129: }

131: function objectCapabilityFacts(project: LocationProject, object: SceneObject): ObjectCapabilityFacts {
132:   const source = normalizePoseableCharacterSource(object.poseableCharacter, object.type);
133:   const renderable = isRenderableProductionObject(project, object)
134:     && (!object.modelAssetId || assetUsable(project, object.modelAssetId));
135:   const blockingReasons: string[] = [];
136:   if (!renderable) blockingReasons.push(`Object "${object.id}" is not renderable or its model asset is unavailable.`);
137: 
138:   const base = {
139:     objectId: object.id,
140:     renderable,
141:     rigidTransformable: renderable,
142:     poseable: false,
143:     deforming: false,
144:     timelinePoseable: false,
145:     mappedJoints: [] as HumanJointId[],
146:     missingRequiredJoints: [] as HumanJointId[],
147:     readiness: 'unsupported' as EntityCapabilityReadiness,
148:     blockingReasons,
149:   };
150: 
151:   if (!source) {
152:     return {
153:       ...base,
154:       readiness: renderable ? 'ready_static_only' : 'unsupported',
155:     };
156:   }
157: 
158:   if (source.kind === 'builtin') {
159:     return {
160:       ...base,
161:       poseable: renderable,
162:       deforming: renderable,
163:       timelinePoseable: renderable,
164:       mappedJoints: [...HUMAN_JOINT_IDS],
165:       readiness: renderable ? 'ready' : 'unsupported',
166:     };
167:   }
168: 
169:   const resolved = resolvePoseableRigForObject(object, project.assets);
170:   const rig = resolved?.rig;
171:   if (!rig) {
172:     return {
173:       ...base,
174:       readiness: renderable ? 'unsupported' : 'unsupported',
175:       blockingReasons: [...blockingReasons, `Poseable rig for object "${object.id}" is missing.`],
176:     };
177:   }
178: 
179:   if (rig.requiresRerigging) {
180:     return {
181:       ...base,
182:       readiness: 'requires_rerigging',
183:       blockingReasons: [...blockingReasons, `Rig "${rig.id}" is marked requiresRerigging and cannot perform pose-dependent work.`],
184:     };
185:   }
186: 
187:   if (source.kind === 'importedRig') {
188:     const binding = rig.importedRigBinding;
189:     const sourceAssetId = binding?.sourceAssetId;
190:     const coverage = requiredJointCoverage(Object.keys(binding?.boneMap ?? {}) as HumanJointId[]);
191:     const sourceAvailable = assetUsable(project, sourceAssetId);
192:     if (!sourceAvailable) {
193:       return {
194:         ...base,
195:         mappedJoints: coverage.mappedJoints,
196:         missingRequiredJoints: coverage.missingRequiredJoints,
197:         readiness: 'unsupported',
198:         blockingReasons: [...blockingReasons, `Imported rig source asset "${sourceAssetId ?? '(missing)'}" is unavailable.`],
199:       };
200:     }
201:     if (!binding) {
202:       return {
203:         ...base,
204:         readiness: 'requires_manual_mapping',
205:         blockingReasons: [...blockingReasons, `Imported rig "${rig.id}" has no preserved humanoid mapping.`],
206:       };
207:     }
208:     if (coverage.missingRequiredJoints.length > 0) {
209:       return {
210:         ...base,
211:         mappedJoints: coverage.mappedJoints,
212:         missingRequiredJoints: coverage.missingRequiredJoints,
213:         readiness: 'requires_manual_mapping',
214:         blockingReasons: [...blockingReasons, `Imported rig is missing required joints: ${coverage.missingRequiredJoints.join(', ')}.`],
215:       };
216:     }
217:     return {
218:       ...base,
219:       poseable: renderable,
220:       deforming: renderable,
221:       timelinePoseable: renderable,
222:       mappedJoints: coverage.mappedJoints,
223:       missingRequiredJoints: [],
224:       readiness: renderable ? 'ready' : 'unsupported',
225:     };
226:   }
227: 
228:   const coverage = requiredJointCoverage(
229:     (rig.skeletonJoints ?? []).filter((jointId) => Boolean(rig.bindMatrices?.[jointId])),
230:   );
231:   const sourceAssetId = rig.originalSourceAssetId ?? rig.sourceMeshAssetId ?? rig.meshAssetId;
232:   const sourceAvailable = assetUsable(project, sourceAssetId);
233:   const hasBindMatrices = Object.keys(rig.bindMatrices ?? {}).length > 0;
234:   const hasSkin = Boolean(rig.skin && usableAutorigSkin(project, rig.skin));
235:   if (!sourceAvailable || !hasBindMatrices || !hasSkin || coverage.missingRequiredJoints.length > 0) {
236:     const reasons = [...blockingReasons];
237:     if (!sourceAvailable) reasons.push(`Autorig source mesh asset "${sourceAssetId ?? '(missing)'}" is unavailable.`);
238:     if (!hasBindMatrices) reasons.push(`Autorig "${rig.id}" has no usable bind matrices.`);
239:     if (!hasSkin) reasons.push(`Autorig "${rig.id}" has no usable skin weights.`);
240:     if (coverage.missingRequiredJoints.length > 0) reasons.push(`Autorig is missing required joints: ${coverage.missingRequiredJoints.join(', ')}.`);
241:     return {
242:       ...base,
243:       mappedJoints: coverage.mappedJoints,
244:       missingRequiredJoints: coverage.missingRequiredJoints,
245:       readiness: 'requires_rerigging',
246:       blockingReasons: reasons,
247:     };
248:   }
249:   return {
250:     ...base,
251:     poseable: renderable,
252:     deforming: renderable,
253:     timelinePoseable: renderable,
254:     mappedJoints: coverage.mappedJoints,
255:     missingRequiredJoints: [],
256:     readiness: renderable ? 'ready' : 'unsupported',
257:   };
258: }

260: function groupIsComplete(project: LocationProject, groupId: string): boolean {
261:   const group = project.scene.objectGroups?.[groupId];
262:   if (!group || group.objectIds.length === 0) return false;
263:   if (group.objectIds.some((objectId) => !project.scene.objects.some((object) => object.id === objectId))) return false;
264:   if (!group.sourceImportId) return true;
265:   const importedIds = project.scene.objects
266:     .filter((object) => object.importedModel?.sourceImportId === group.sourceImportId)
267:     .map((object) => object.id);
268:   return importedIds.every((objectId) => group.objectIds.includes(objectId));
269: }

271: function bindingForEntity(config: ProductionConfiguration, entityId: string): ProductionEntityBinding | undefined {
272:   return config.bindings[entityId]
273:     ?? config.bindings[`cast.${entityId}`]
274:     ?? config.bindings[`props.${entityId}`]
275:     ?? config.bindings[`locations.${entityId}`];
276: }
277: 
278: function aggregateBindingCapabilities(
279:   project: LocationProject,
280:   entityId: string,
281:   binding: ProductionEntityBinding | undefined,
282: ): EntityCapabilityProfile {
283:   if (!binding) {
284:     return {
285:       entityId,
286:       objectIds: [],
287:       renderable: false,
288:       rigidTransformable: false,
289:       assemblyComplete: false,
290:       poseable: false,
291:       deforming: false,
292:       timelinePoseable: false,
293:       mappedJoints: [],
294:       missingRequiredJoints: [],
295:       readiness: 'unsupported',
296:       blockingReasons: [`No production binding exists for entity "${entityId}".`],
297:     };
298:   }
299: 
300:   const objectIds = resolveProductionBindingObjectIds(project, binding);
301:   const memberProfiles = Object.fromEntries(objectIds.flatMap((objectId) => {
302:     const object = project.scene.objects.find((candidate) => candidate.id === objectId);
303:     return object ? [[objectId, {
304:       entityId: objectId,
305:       objectIds: [objectId],
306:       assemblyComplete: true,
307:       ...objectCapabilityFacts(project, object),
308:     } satisfies EntityCapabilityProfile]] : [];
309:   }));
310:   const members = Object.values(memberProfiles);
311:   const missingGroup = binding.kind === 'group' && !groupIsComplete(project, binding.groupId);
312:   const locationWithoutGeometry = binding.kind === 'location' && objectIds.length === 0;
313:   const assemblyComplete = !missingGroup && !locationWithoutGeometry && (
314:     binding.kind !== 'object' || objectIds.length === 1
315:   );
316:   const blockingReasons = unique([
317:     ...members.flatMap((member) => member.blockingReasons),
318:     ...(missingGroup ? [`Object group "${binding.kind === 'group' ? binding.groupId : ''}" is empty, stale, or incomplete.`] : []),
319:     ...(locationWithoutGeometry ? ['Prepared location has no usable geometry.'] : []),
320:   ]);
321:   const renderable = members.length > 0 && members.every((member) => member.renderable);
322:   const rigidTransformable = assemblyComplete && renderable;
323:   const poseMembers = members.filter((member) => member.poseable || member.readiness === 'ready');
324:   const poseable = poseMembers.length > 0 && poseMembers.every((member) => member.poseable);
325:   const deforming = poseMembers.length > 0 && poseMembers.every((member) => member.deforming);
326:   const timelinePoseable = poseMembers.length > 0 && poseMembers.every((member) => member.timelinePoseable);
327:   const mappedJoints = HUMAN_JOINT_IDS.filter((jointId) => members.some((member) => member.mappedJoints.includes(jointId)));
328:   const missingRequiredJoints = unique(members.flatMap((member) => member.missingRequiredJoints));
329: 
330:   let readiness: EntityCapabilityReadiness;
331:   if (!assemblyComplete || !renderable) readiness = 'unsupported';
332:   else if (members.some((member) => member.readiness === 'requires_rerigging')) readiness = 'requires_rerigging';
333:   else if (members.some((member) => member.readiness === 'requires_manual_mapping')) readiness = 'requires_manual_mapping';
334:   else if (poseable && deforming && timelinePoseable) readiness = 'ready';
335:   else readiness = 'ready_static_only';
336: 
337:   return {
338:     entityId,
339:     binding,
340:     objectIds,
341:     renderable,
342:     rigidTransformable,
343:     assemblyComplete,
344:     poseable,
345:     deforming,
346:     timelinePoseable,
347:     mappedJoints,
348:     missingRequiredJoints,
349:     readiness,
350:     blockingReasons,
351:     ...(members.length > 0 ? { memberProfiles } : {}),
352:   };
353: }

355: export function inspectEntityCapability(
356:   project: LocationProject,
357:   entityId: string,
358: ): EntityCapabilityProfile {
359:   const config = getProductionConfiguration(project);
360:   return aggregateBindingCapabilities(project, entityId, bindingForEntity(config, entityId));

363: function mergeRequirements(
364:   target: Map<string, { shotId?: string; requires: EntityCapabilityRequirement['requires'] }>,
365:   entityId: string,
366:   requires: EntityCapabilityRequirement['requires'],
367:   shotId?: string,
368: ): void {
369:   const existing = target.get(entityId) ?? { requires: {} };
370:   const joints = unique([...(existing.requires.joints ?? []), ...(requires.joints ?? [])]);
371:   target.set(entityId, {
372:     shotId: existing.shotId ?? shotId,
373:     requires: {
374:       ...existing.requires,
375:       ...requires,
376:       ...(joints.length > 0 ? { joints } : {}),
377:     },
378:   });
379: }

381: function requirementsFromManifest(
382:   manifest: PrevisProductionManifestV1,
383:   target: Map<string, { shotId?: string; requires: EntityCapabilityRequirement['requires'] }>,
384: ): void {
385:   for (const character of manifest.cast) {
386:     if (character.defaultPose) {
387:       mergeRequirements(target, character.id, {
388:         poseable: true,
389:         deforming: true,
390:       });
391:     }
392:   }
393:   for (const shot of manifest.shots) {
394:     for (const blocking of shot.blocking ?? []) {
395:       if (blocking.pose) {
396:         mergeRequirements(target, blocking.subject, {
397:           poseable: true,
398:           deforming: true,
399:         }, shot.id);
400:       }
401:     }
402:     for (const keyframe of shot.motion?.keyframes ?? []) {
403:       for (const staging of keyframe.staging ?? []) {
404:         if (staging.posePreset) {
405:           mergeRequirements(target, staging.subject, {
406:             poseable: true,
407:             deforming: true,
408:             timelinePoseable: true,
409:           }, shot.id);
410:         }
411:       }
412:     }
413:   }
414: }

416: function requirementDiagnostics(
417:   profile: EntityCapabilityProfile,
418:   requires: EntityCapabilityRequirement['requires'],
419:   entityId: string,
420:   shotId?: string,
421: ): ProductionCapabilityDiagnostic[] {
422:   const diagnostics: ProductionCapabilityDiagnostic[] = [];
423:   const context = shotId ? ` for shot "${shotId}"` : '';
424:   const check = (condition: boolean | undefined, actual: boolean, capability: string) => {
425:     if (!condition || actual) return;
426:     diagnostics.push({
427:       code: capability === 'poseability' && profile.readiness === 'ready_static_only'
428:         ? 'required_poseable_asset_static'
429:         : profile.readiness === 'requires_manual_mapping'
430:           ? 'requires_manual_mapping'
431:           : profile.readiness === 'requires_rerigging'
432:             ? 'requires_rerigging'
433:             : 'capability_requirement_unsatisfied',
434:       severity: 'error',
435:       entityId,
436:       ...(shotId ? { shotId } : {}),
437:       message: `Entity "${entityId}" does not satisfy ${capability}${context}. ${profile.blockingReasons.join(' ')}`.trim(),
438:     });
439:   };
440:   check(requires.renderable, profile.renderable, 'renderable');
441:   check(requires.rigidAssembly, profile.rigidTransformable, 'rigid assembly');
442:   check(requires.poseable, profile.poseable, 'poseability');
443:   check(requires.deforming, profile.deforming, 'deformation');
444:   check(requires.timelinePoseable, profile.timelinePoseable, 'timeline poseability');
445:   if (requires.joints?.length) {
446:     const missing = requires.joints.filter((jointId) => (
447:       !profile.mappedJoints.includes(jointId)
448:       && !(jointId === 'spine' && profile.mappedJoints.includes('chest'))
449:     ));
450:     if (missing.length > 0) {
451:       diagnostics.push({
452:         code: 'required_joint_missing',
453:         severity: 'error',
454:         entityId,
455:         ...(shotId ? { shotId } : {}),
456:         message: `Entity "${entityId}" is missing required joints ${missing.join(', ')}${context}.`,
457:       });
458:     }
459:   }
460:   return diagnostics;
461: }

463: export function validateProductionCapabilities(
464:   project: LocationProject,
465:   manifest?: PrevisProductionManifestV1,
466: ): ProductionCapabilityValidationResult {
467:   const config = getProductionConfiguration(project);
468:   const requirements = new Map<string, { shotId?: string; requires: EntityCapabilityRequirement['requires'] }>();
469:   for (const [shotId, contract] of Object.entries(config.shotContracts)) {
470:     for (const requirement of contract.capabilityRequirements ?? []) {
471:       mergeRequirements(requirements, requirement.entityId, requirement.requires, shotId);
472:     }
473:   }
474:   if (manifest) requirementsFromManifest(manifest, requirements);
475: 
476:   const profiles: Record<string, EntityCapabilityProfile> = {};
477:   const diagnostics: ProductionCapabilityDiagnostic[] = [];
478:   for (const [entityId, entry] of requirements) {
479:     const profile = inspectEntityCapability(project, entityId);
480:     profiles[entityId] = profile;
481:     if (!profile.binding) diagnostics.push({
482:       code: 'capability_binding_missing',
483:       severity: 'error',
484:       entityId,
485:       ...(entry.shotId ? { shotId: entry.shotId } : {}),
486:       message: `No prepared binding exists for capability-required entity "${entityId}".`,
487:     });
488:     diagnostics.push(...requirementDiagnostics(profile, entry.requires, entityId, entry.shotId));
489:   }
490:   return {
491:     ok: diagnostics.every((item) => item.severity !== 'error'),
492:     profiles,
493:     diagnostics,
494:     checkedEntityIds: Object.keys(profiles),
495:     checkedShotIds: unique([...requirements.values()].flatMap((item) => item.shotId ? [item.shotId] : [])),
496:   };
497: }

499: function approvedSubstitution(
500:   config: ProductionConfiguration,
501:   entityId: string,
502:   requestedPose: string,
503:   shotId?: string,
504: ): PoseSubstitutionApproval | undefined {
505:   return config.poseSubstitutions?.find((approval) => (
506:     approval.entityId === entityId
507:     && approval.requestedPose === requestedPose
508:     && (!shotId || !approval.shotIds || approval.shotIds.includes(shotId))
509:   ));

512: export function resolveProductionPose(input: {
513:   project: LocationProject;
514:   entityId: string;
515:   requestedPose: string;
516:   shotId?: string;
517: }): ProductionPoseResolution {
518:   const { project, entityId, requestedPose, shotId } = input;
519:   const approval = approvedSubstitution(getProductionConfiguration(project), entityId, requestedPose, shotId);
520:   if (approval) {
521:     if (approval.relationship === 'contradictory') {
522:       return {
523:         entityId,
524:         ...(shotId ? { shotId } : {}),
525:         requestedPose,
526:         relationship: 'contradictory',
527:         requiresReview: true,
528:         reason: approval.reason ?? `Approved pose policy marks "${requestedPose}" as contradictory.`,
529:       };
530:     }
531:     const resolvedPose = approval.resolvedPose ? resolvePrevisPosePresetId(approval.resolvedPose) : undefined;
532:     if (!resolvedPose || !getHumanPosePreset(resolvedPose)) {
533:       return {
534:         entityId,
535:         ...(shotId ? { shotId } : {}),
536:         requestedPose,
537:         relationship: 'contradictory',
538:         requiresReview: true,
539:         reason: `Approved substitution for "${requestedPose}" does not name a supported native pose.`,
540:       };
541:     }
542:     return {
543:       entityId,
544:       ...(shotId ? { shotId } : {}),
545:       requestedPose,
546:       resolvedPose,
547:       relationship: approval.relationship,
548:       requiresReview: false,
549:       ...(approval.reason ? { reason: approval.reason } : {}),
550:     };
551:   }
552: 
553:   const native = getHumanPosePreset(requestedPose);
554:   if (native) {
555:     return {
556:       entityId,
557:       ...(shotId ? { shotId } : {}),
558:       requestedPose,
559:       resolvedPose: native.id,
560:       relationship: 'exact',
561:       requiresReview: false,
562:     };
563:   }
564:   const resolvedPose = resolvePrevisPosePresetId(requestedPose);
565:   if (!resolvedPose || !getHumanPosePreset(resolvedPose)) {
566:     return {
567:       entityId,
568:       ...(shotId ? { shotId } : {}),
569:       requestedPose,
570:       relationship: 'contradictory',
571:       requiresReview: true,
572:       reason: `Pose "${requestedPose}" has no deterministic native or approved resolution.`,
573:     };
574:   }
575:   return {
576:     entityId,
577:     ...(shotId ? { shotId } : {}),
578:     requestedPose,
579:     resolvedPose,
580:     relationship: 'approximate',
581:     requiresReview: true,
582:     reason: `Pose "${requestedPose}" uses approximate native preset "${resolvedPose}" until a project substitution is approved.`,
583:   };

119:   for (const [, binding] of Object.entries(configuration.bindings)) {
120:     // Location bindings describe set geography, not a shot-presence subject.
121:     if (binding.kind === 'object') {
122:       boundDynamicObjectIds.add(binding.objectId);
123:     } else if (binding.kind === 'group') {
124:       for (const objectId of groups[binding.groupId]?.objectIds ?? []) {
125:         boundDynamicObjectIds.add(objectId);

135:     const isDynamic = DYNAMIC_CLASSES.has(classification)
136:       || explicitlyDynamic

147: /** Resolve the base presence state, honoring explicit base or legacy top-level fields. */

155: /** Resolve expected visibility at a timeline sample. */
156: export function resolveShotPresenceAtTime(
157:   contract: ShotPresenceContract,
158:   timeSeconds: number,
159: ): ShotPresenceState {
160:   const timeline = [...(contract.timeline ?? [])].sort((a, b) => a.timeSeconds - b.timeSeconds);
161:   let current = resolveShotPresenceBase(contract);
162:   for (const entry of timeline) {
163:     if (entry.timeSeconds > timeSeconds) break;
164:     current = {
165:       expectedVisibleObjectIds: entry.expectedVisibleObjectIds,
166:       expectedVisibleGroupIds: entry.expectedVisibleGroupIds,
167:     };
168:   }
169:   return current;
170: }

173:   contract: ShotPresenceContract,
174:   entityId: string,
175:   fromVisible: boolean,
176:   toVisible: boolean,
177: ): boolean {
178:   return (contract.allowedTransitions ?? []).some((transition) => (
179:     transition.entityId === entityId
180:     && transition.from === fromVisible
181:     && transition.to === toVisible
182:   ));

185: /** Find a persisted shot contract by stable shot id, production id, or number. */
186: export function getShotPresenceContract(
187:   project: LocationProject,
188:   shot: Pick<Shot, 'id' | 'shotNumber' | 'productionShotId'>,
189: ): ShotPresenceContract | undefined {
190:   const contracts = getProductionConfiguration(project).shotContracts;
191:   for (const key of [shot.id, shot.productionShotId, shot.shotNumber]) {
192:     if (key && contracts[key]?.presence) return contracts[key].presence;
193:   }
194:   return undefined;
