197: /** Resolve direct object ids and complete logical group member sets. */
198: export function resolveExpectedShotPresence(
199:   project: LocationProject,
200:   contract?: ShotPresenceContract,
201:   timeSeconds = 0,
202: ): ShotPresenceResolution {
203:   const dynamic = new Set(deriveDynamicObjectUniverse(project).map((item) => item.objectId));
204:   const expected = new Set<string>();
205:   const diagnostics: ShotPresenceDiagnostic[] = [];
206:   const state = contract ? resolveShotPresenceAtTime(contract, timeSeconds) : {
207:     expectedVisibleObjectIds: [],
208:     expectedVisibleGroupIds: [],
209:   };
210:   const expectedVisibleObjectIds = state.expectedVisibleObjectIds;
211:   const expectedVisibleGroupIds = state.expectedVisibleGroupIds;
212: 
213:   for (const objectId of expectedVisibleObjectIds) {
214:     const object = project.scene.objects.find((item) => item.id === objectId);
215:     if (!object || !dynamic.has(objectId)) {
216:       diagnostics.push({
217:         code: 'expected_dynamic_object_missing',
218:         message: `Expected dynamic object "${objectId}" does not exist or is not classified as dynamic.`,
219:         objectId,
220:       });
221:       continue;
222:     }
223:     expected.add(objectId);
224:   }
225: 
226:   for (const groupId of expectedVisibleGroupIds) {
227:     const group = project.scene.objectGroups?.[groupId];
228:     if (!group) {
229:       diagnostics.push({
230:         code: 'expected_dynamic_object_missing',
231:         message: `Expected dynamic group "${groupId}" does not exist.`,
232:         groupId,
233:       });
234:       continue;
235:     }
236:     const memberIds = [...new Set(group.objectIds)];
237:     if (memberIds.length === 0) {
238:       diagnostics.push({
239:         code: 'expected_dynamic_object_missing',
240:         message: `Expected dynamic group "${groupId}" is empty.`,
241:         groupId,
242:       });
243:       continue;
244:     }
245:     for (const objectId of memberIds) {
246:       if (!project.scene.objects.some((object) => object.id === objectId)) {
247:         diagnostics.push({
248:           code: 'expected_dynamic_object_missing',
249:           message: `Expected dynamic group "${groupId}" is missing member "${objectId}".`,
250:           groupId,
251:           objectId,
252:         });
253:       } else if (dynamic.has(objectId)) {
254:         expected.add(objectId);
255:       }
256:     }
257:   }
258: 
259:   return {
260:     contractPresent: contract !== undefined,
261:     allowUnspecifiedDynamicObjects: contract?.allowUnspecifiedDynamicObjects ?? false,
262:     expectedVisibleObjectIds: [...expected],
263:     expectedVisibleGroupIds: [...expectedVisibleGroupIds],
264:     diagnostics,
265:   };
266: }

268: /** Inspect a shot's base state and all meaningful timeline visibility samples. */
269: export function inspectShotPresence(
270:   project: LocationProject,
271:   shotInput: Shot | string,
272:   contractInput?: ShotPresenceContract,
273: ): ShotPresenceInspection {
274:   const shot = typeof shotInput === 'string'
275:     ? project.shots.find((candidate) => candidate.id === shotInput)
276:     : project.shots.find((candidate) => candidate.id === shotInput.id) ?? shotInput;
277:   const shotId = typeof shotInput === 'string' ? shotInput : shotInput.id;
278:   if (!shot) {
279:     const diagnostic: ShotPresenceDiagnostic = {
280:       code: 'shot_missing',
281:       message: `Shot "${shotId}" does not exist.`,
282:       shotId,
283:     };
284:     return {
285:       ok: false,
286:       shotId,
287:       contractPresent: false,
288:       expectedVisibleObjectIds: [],
289:       expectedVisibleGroupIds: [],
290:       dynamicObjectIds: [],
291:       actualVisibleObjectIds: [],
292:       samples: [],
293:       diagnostics: [diagnostic],
294:     };
295:   }
296: 
297:   const contract = contractInput ?? getShotPresenceContract(project, shot);
298:   const hasTemporalContract = Boolean(contract?.timeline?.length || contract?.allowedTransitions?.length);
299:   const resolution = resolveExpectedShotPresence(project, contract);
300:   const dynamic = deriveDynamicObjectUniverse(project);
301:   const dynamicIds = dynamic.map((item) => item.objectId);
302:   const dynamicIdSet = new Set(dynamicIds);
303:   const diagnostics: ShotPresenceDiagnostic[] = resolution.diagnostics.map((item) => ({ ...item, shotId }));
304: 
305:   for (const item of dynamic) {
306:     if (item.classification === 'unclassified') {
307:       diagnostics.push({
308:         code: 'unclassified_dynamic_object',
309:         message: `Dynamic object "${item.objectId}" has no usable production classification.`,
310:         shotId,
311:         objectId: item.objectId,
312:       });
313:     }
314:   }
315: 
316:   if (!contract) {
317:     const uniqueDiagnostics = dedupeDiagnostics(diagnostics);
318:     return {
319:       ok: uniqueDiagnostics.length === 0,
320:       shotId,
321:       contractPresent: false,
322:       expectedVisibleObjectIds: [],
323:       expectedVisibleGroupIds: [],
324:       dynamicObjectIds: dynamicIds,
325:       actualVisibleObjectIds: [],
326:       samples: [],
327:       diagnostics: uniqueDiagnostics,
328:     };
329:   }
330: 
331:   const sampleTimes = presenceSampleTimes(shot);
332:   const samples: ShotPresenceSample[] = [];
333:   const expectedBySample = new Map<number, Set<string>>();
334:   for (const timeSeconds of sampleTimes) {
335:     const sampleResolution = resolveExpectedShotPresence(project, contract, timeSeconds);
336:     diagnostics.push(...sampleResolution.diagnostics.map((item) => ({ ...item, shotId, sampleTimeSeconds: timeSeconds })));
337:     const expected = new Set(sampleResolution.expectedVisibleObjectIds);
338:     expectedBySample.set(timeSeconds, expected);
339:     const objectOverrides = timeSeconds === 0 && shot.cameraKeyframes.length === 0
340:       ? shot.objectOverrides ?? {}
341:       : interpolateObjectOverrides(
342:         shot.cameraKeyframes,
343:         timeSeconds,
344:         shot.objectOverrides,
345:         project.scene.objects,
346:       );
347:     const visibleDynamicObjectIds = visibleDynamicIds(project, objectOverrides, dynamicIdSet);
348:     const previousVisibleObjectIds = samples.at(-1)?.visibleDynamicObjectIds;
349:     const sampleDiagnostics = samplePresenceDiagnostics({
350:       project,
351:       dynamic,
352:       visibleDynamicObjectIds,
353:       expected,
354:       resolution: sampleResolution,
355:       shotId,
356:       timeSeconds,
357:       contract,
358:       previousVisibleObjectIds,
359:     });
360:     samples.push({ timeSeconds, visibleDynamicObjectIds, diagnostics: sampleDiagnostics });
361:     diagnostics.push(...sampleDiagnostics);
362:   }
363: 
364:   if (!hasTemporalContract && samples.length > 1) {
365:     const first = samples[0]?.visibleDynamicObjectIds ?? [];
366:     const firstKey = first.join('|');
367:     if (samples.some((sample) => sample.visibleDynamicObjectIds.join('|') !== firstKey)) {
368:       diagnostics.push({
369:         code: 'dynamic_presence_changed_over_time',
370:         message: `Dynamic object presence changes across timeline samples for shot "${shotId}".`,
371:         shotId,
372:       });
373:     }
374:   } else if (contract.allowedTransitions?.length && samples.length > 1) {
375:     for (let index = 1; index < samples.length; index += 1) {
376:       const previous = new Set(samples[index - 1]!.visibleDynamicObjectIds);
377:       const current = new Set(samples[index]!.visibleDynamicObjectIds);
378:       const changedIds = [...new Set([...previous, ...current])].filter((objectId) => (
379:         previous.has(objectId) !== current.has(objectId)
380:       ));
381:       for (const objectId of changedIds) {
382:         const fromVisible = previous.has(objectId);
383:         const toVisible = current.has(objectId);
384:         if (!transitionAllowed(contract, objectId, fromVisible, toVisible)) {
385:           diagnostics.push({
386:             code: 'dynamic_presence_changed_over_time',
387:             message: `Undeclared visibility transition for "${objectId}" between timeline samples.`,
388:             shotId,
389:             objectId,
390:             sampleTimeSeconds: samples[index]!.timeSeconds,
391:           });
392:         }
393:       }
394:     }
395:   }
396: 
397:   const uniqueDiagnostics = dedupeDiagnostics(diagnostics);
398:   const firstSample = samples[0];
399:   return {
400:     ok: uniqueDiagnostics.length === 0,
401:     shotId,
402:     contractPresent: true,
403:     expectedVisibleObjectIds: firstSample
404:       ? [...(expectedBySample.get(firstSample.timeSeconds) ?? [])]
405:       : resolution.expectedVisibleObjectIds,
406:     expectedVisibleGroupIds: resolveShotPresenceBase(contract).expectedVisibleGroupIds,
407:     dynamicObjectIds: dynamicIds,
408:     actualVisibleObjectIds: firstSample?.visibleDynamicObjectIds ?? [],
409:     samples,
410:     diagnostics: uniqueDiagnostics,
411:   };
412: }

423: /**
424:  * Apply a closed-world visibility state while preserving every camera,
425:  * transform, pose, and non-visibility override. Timeline snapshots are made
426:  * explicit so later interpolation cannot reintroduce an inherited object.
427:  */
428: export function applyClosedWorldShotPresence(
429:   project: LocationProject,
430:   shotInput: Shot | string,
431:   contractInput?: ShotPresenceContract,
432: ): ShotPresenceApplicationResult {
433:   const shot = typeof shotInput === 'string'
434:     ? project.shots.find((candidate) => candidate.id === shotInput)
435:     : project.shots.find((candidate) => candidate.id === shotInput.id) ?? shotInput;
436:   const shotId = typeof shotInput === 'string' ? shotInput : shotInput.id;
437:   const contract = contractInput ?? (shot ? getShotPresenceContract(project, shot) : undefined);
438:   const before = inspectShotPresence(project, shot ?? shotId, contract);
439:   if (!shot || !contract || before.diagnostics.some((item) => (
440:     item.code === 'expected_dynamic_object_missing'
441:     || item.code === 'shot_missing'
442:     || item.code === 'unclassified_dynamic_object'
443:   ))) {
444:     return {
445:       ok: false,
446:       project,
447:       inspection: before,
448:       diagnostics: before.diagnostics,
449:     };
450:   }
451: 
452:   const expected = new Set(before.expectedVisibleObjectIds);
453:   const dynamicIds = before.dynamicObjectIds;
454:   let nextShot = structuredClone(shot);
455:   for (const objectId of dynamicIds) {
456:     const object = project.scene.objects.find((candidate) => candidate.id === objectId);
457:     if (!object) continue;
458:     nextShot.objectOverrides = updateShotObjectOverrides(nextShot, object, {
459:       visible: expected.has(objectId),
460:     });
461:   }
462: 
463:   nextShot.cameraKeyframes = nextShot.cameraKeyframes.map((keyframe) => ({
464:     ...keyframe,
465:     objectOverrides: applyVisibilityToOverrides(
466:       keyframe.objectOverrides ?? nextShot.objectOverrides,
467:       dynamicIds,
468:       expected,
469:     ),
470:   }));
471:   nextShot.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();
472: 
473:   const nextProject: LocationProject = {
474:     ...project,
475:     shots: project.shots.map((candidate) => candidate.id === shot.id ? nextShot : candidate),
476:   };
477:   const inspection = inspectShotPresence(nextProject, nextShot, contract);
478:   return {
479:     ok: inspection.ok,
480:     project: nextProject,
481:     inspection,
482:     diagnostics: inspection.diagnostics,
483:   };
484: }
485: 
486: function applyVisibilityToOverrides(
487:   source: ShotObjectOverrides | undefined,
488:   dynamicIds: readonly string[],
489:   expected: ReadonlySet<string>,
490: ): ShotObjectOverrides {
491:   const next = structuredClone(source ?? {});
492:   for (const objectId of dynamicIds) {
493:     next[objectId] = {
494:       ...(next[objectId] ?? {}),
495:       visible: expected.has(objectId),
496:     };
497:   }
498:   return next;
499: }
500: 
501: function visibleDynamicIds(
502:   project: LocationProject,
503:   overrides: ShotObjectOverrides,
504:   dynamicIds: ReadonlySet<string>,
505: ): string[] {
506:   const resolved = resolveSceneObjectsForShot(project, { objectOverrides: overrides });
507:   return resolved
508:     .filter((object) => dynamicIds.has(object.id) && object.visible !== false)
509:     .map((object) => object.id);
510: }

512: function samplePresenceDiagnostics(input: {
513:   project: LocationProject;
514:   dynamic: DynamicObjectDescriptor[];
515:   visibleDynamicObjectIds: string[];
516:   expected: ReadonlySet<string>;
517:   resolution: ShotPresenceResolution;
518:   shotId: string;
519:   timeSeconds: number;
520:   contract?: ShotPresenceContract;
521:   previousVisibleObjectIds?: readonly string[];
522: }): ShotPresenceDiagnostic[] {
523:   const diagnostics: ShotPresenceDiagnostic[] = [];
524:   const visible = new Set(input.visibleDynamicObjectIds);
525:   if (!input.resolution.contractPresent) return diagnostics;
526: 
527:   for (const objectId of input.expected) {
528:     if (!visible.has(objectId)) {
529:       diagnostics.push({
530:         code: 'expected_dynamic_object_hidden',
531:         message: `Expected dynamic object "${objectId}" is hidden at ${input.timeSeconds.toFixed(3)}s.`,
532:         shotId: input.shotId,
533:         objectId,
534:         sampleTimeSeconds: input.timeSeconds,
535:       });
536:     }
537:   }
538: 
539:   if (!input.resolution.allowUnspecifiedDynamicObjects) {
540:     const previousVisible = new Set(input.previousVisibleObjectIds ?? []);
541:     for (const objectId of input.visibleDynamicObjectIds) {
542:       if (!input.expected.has(objectId)) {
543:         if (
544:           input.contract
545:           && !previousVisible.has(objectId)
546:           && transitionAllowed(input.contract, objectId, false, true)
547:         ) {
548:           continue;
549:         }
550:         diagnostics.push({
551:           code: 'unexpected_dynamic_object',
552:           message: `Unexpected dynamic object "${objectId}" is visible at ${input.timeSeconds.toFixed(3)}s.`,
553:           shotId: input.shotId,
554:           objectId,
555:           sampleTimeSeconds: input.timeSeconds,
556:         });
557:       }
558:     }
559:   }
560: 
561:   for (const [groupId, group] of Object.entries(input.project.scene.objectGroups ?? {})) {
562:     const memberIds = [...new Set(group.objectIds)].filter((objectId) => (
563:       input.dynamic.some((item) => item.objectId === objectId)
564:     ));
565:     if (memberIds.length < 2) continue;
566:     const visibleCount = memberIds.filter((objectId) => visible.has(objectId)).length;
567:     if (visibleCount > 0 && visibleCount < memberIds.length) {
568:       diagnostics.push({
569:         code: 'partial_group_visibility',
570:         message: `Multipart group "${groupId}" is only partially visible at ${input.timeSeconds.toFixed(3)}s.`,
571:         shotId: input.shotId,
572:         groupId,
573:         sampleTimeSeconds: input.timeSeconds,
574:       });
575:     }
576:   }
577:   return diagnostics;
578: }
579: 
580: function presenceSampleTimes(shot: Shot): number[] {
581:   const keyframes = getSortedCameraKeyframes(shot.cameraKeyframes);
582:   if (keyframes.length === 0) return [0];
583:   const times = new Set<number>([0]);
584:   for (const keyframe of keyframes) times.add(Math.max(0, keyframe.timeSeconds));
585:   for (let index = 1; index < keyframes.length; index += 1) {
586:     const start = keyframes[index - 1]!.timeSeconds;
587:     const end = keyframes[index]!.timeSeconds;
588:     if (end > start) times.add(start + (end - start) / 2);
589:   }
590:   return [...times].sort((a, b) => a - b);
591: }
592: 
593: function dedupeDiagnostics(items: ShotPresenceDiagnostic[]): ShotPresenceDiagnostic[] {
594:   const seen = new Set<string>();
595:   return items.filter((item) => {
596:     const key = [
597:       item.code,
598:       item.shotId ?? '',
599:       item.objectId ?? '',
600:       item.groupId ?? '',
601:       item.sampleTimeSeconds ?? '',
602:     ].join('|');
603:     if (seen.has(key)) return false;
604:     seen.add(key);
605:     return true;
606:   });
607: }

118:     chainSource = {
119:       ...chainSource,
120:       project: prepared.prepared.nextProject,
121:       workspace: prepared.prepared.nextSelection.workspace,
122:       selectedObjectIds: prepared.prepared.nextSelection.selectedObjectIds,
123:       selectedShotId: prepared.prepared.nextSelection.selectedShotId,
124:       activePanoId: prepared.prepared.nextActivePanoId ?? chainSource.activePanoId,
125:     };
126:   }
127: 
128:   if (!lastPrepared) {
129:     return { ok: false, diagnostics: [agentError('compile_empty', 'Production compile produced no plans.')] };
130:   }
131: 
132:   return { ok: true, lastPrepared, commandCount };
133: }

162: export async function bindAgentManifestAssets(input: {
163:   manifest: unknown;
164:   bindings: Record<string, string>;
165: }): Promise<AgentProductionManifestValidateResult> {
166:   if (useAgentControlStore.getState().controlMode !== 'read-write') {
167:     return {
168:       ok: false,
169:       diagnostics: [writeAccessRequiredDiagnostic('bindManifestAssets')],
170:     };

174:   if (parsed.errors.length > 0 || !parsed.manifest) {
175:     return {

177:       diagnostics: mapPrevisDiagnostics(parsed.errors),
178:     };
179:   }
180: 
181:   const manifestIds = new Set([
182:     ...parsed.manifest.cast.map((entry) => entry.id),
183:     ...(parsed.manifest.props ?? []).map((entry) => entry.id),
184:     ...parsed.manifest.locations.map((entry) => entry.id),
185:   ]);
186:   const missingBindings = Object.keys(input.bindings).filter((key) => !manifestIds.has(key));
187:   if (missingBindings.length > 0) {

191:     };
192:   }
193: 
194:   const project = useProjectStore.getState().project;
195:   const missingObjects = Object.values(input.bindings).filter((objectId) => (
196:     !project.scene.objects.some((object) => object.id === objectId)
197:   ));
198:   if (missingObjects.length > 0) {
199:     return {
200:       ok: false,
201:       diagnostics: [agentError('object_not_found', 'Bound scene objects not found: ' + missingObjects.join(', ') + '.')],
202:     };
203:   }
204: 
205:   const runDestructive = useProjectSafetyStore.getState().runDestructiveProjectMutation;
206:   if (!runDestructive) {
207:     return {
208:       ok: false,
209:       diagnostics: [agentError('persistence_not_ready', 'Project persistence is not ready.')],
210:     };
211:   }
212: 
213:   await runDestructive('Bind manifest assets', () => {
214:     useProjectStore.setState((state) => ({
215:       project: touchProject({
216:         ...state.project,
217:         workflow: {
218:           ...state.project.workflow,
219:           productionManifestAssetBindings: { ...input.bindings },
220:         },
221:       }),
222:     }));
223:   });
224: 
225:   const locationBindingIds = Object.keys(input.bindings).filter((id) => (
226:     parsed.manifest!.locations.some((location) => location.id === id)
227:   ));
228:   const bindingWarnings = locationBindingIds.length > 0
229:     ? [agentWarning(
230:       'location_binding_limited',
231:       'Simple locationId→objectId binding records only the object reference and zone origin. '
232:         + 'Anchors, blocker geometry, and template geography are not populated — shots may lack '
233:         + 'location-specific solver context until rich location bindings are supported.',
234:     )]
235:     : [];
236: 
237:   return {
238:     ok: true,
239:     shotCount: parsed.manifest.shots.length,
240:     diagnostics: [
241:       ...bindingWarnings,
242:       ...mapPrevisDiagnostics(parsed.warnings.filter((item) => item.severity === 'warning')),
243:     ],
244:   };
245: }

251: export function previewAgentProductionCompile(input: { manifest: unknown }): AgentProductionCompilePreviewResult {
252:   const parsed = parsePrevisProductionManifest(input.manifest);
253:   if (parsed.errors.length > 0 || !parsed.manifest) {
254:     return {
255:       ok: false,
256:       diagnostics: mapPrevisDiagnostics(parsed.errors),
257:     };
258:   }
259: 
260:   const project = useProjectStore.getState().project;
261:   const entityBindings = buildProductionCompileEntityBindings(project);
262:   const locationBindings = buildProductionCompileLocationBindings(project);
263:   const result = compileProduction(parsed.manifest, {
264:     assetBindings: readCompileAssetBindings(project),
265:     entityBindings,
266:     locationBindings,
267:     presenceProject: project,
268:     existingShotIds: existingShotIdsForManifest(project, parsed.manifest),
269:   });
270:   const setupPlans = plansForProductionCompile(result);
271:   const mergedPlan = mergeAgentPlans(setupPlans);
272:   const chained = chainPreparePlans([mergedPlan], readLiveSource());
273:   if (!chained.ok) {
274:     return { ok: false, diagnostics: chained.diagnostics };
275:   }
276: 
277:   return {
278:     ok: result.ok,
279:     planCount: setupPlans.length,
280:     commandCount: chained.commandCount,
281:     diagnostics: mapPrevisDiagnostics(result.diagnostics.filter((item) => item.severity === 'error')),
282:   };
283: }

285: export async function applyAgentProductionCompile(input: {
286:   manifest: unknown;
287:   preserveCurrentAsRecovery?: boolean;
288:   onlyShotIds?: string[];
289: }) {
290:   if (useAgentControlStore.getState().controlMode !== 'read-write') {
291:     return {
292:       ok: false,
293:       diagnostics: [writeAccessRequiredDiagnostic('applyProductionCompile')],
294:     };
295:   }
296: 
297:   const preview = previewAgentProductionCompile({ manifest: input.manifest });
298:   if (!preview.ok) {
299:     return { ok: false, diagnostics: preview.diagnostics };
300:   }
301: 
302:   const parsed = parsePrevisProductionManifest(input.manifest);
303:   if (!parsed.manifest) {
304:     return { ok: false, diagnostics: preview.diagnostics };
305:   }
306: 
307:   const project = useProjectStore.getState().project;
308:   const onlyShotIds = new Set(input.onlyShotIds ?? []);
309:   const skipShotNumbers = onlyShotIds.size > 0
310:     ? new Set(parsed.manifest.shots
311:       .filter((shot) => !onlyShotIds.has(shot.id))
312:       .map((shot) => shot.shotNumber))
313:     : undefined;
314:   const entityBindings = buildProductionCompileEntityBindings(project);
315:   const locationBindings = buildProductionCompileLocationBindings(project);
316:   const result = compileProduction(parsed.manifest, {
317:     assetBindings: readCompileAssetBindings(project),
318:     entityBindings,
319:     locationBindings,
320:     presenceProject: project,
321:     existingShotIds: existingShotIdsForManifest(project, parsed.manifest),
322:     ...(skipShotNumbers ? { skipShotNumbers } : {}),
323:   });
324:   const setupPlans = plansForProductionCompile(result);
325:   const mergedPlan = mergeAgentPlans(setupPlans);
326:   const chained = chainPreparePlans([mergedPlan], readLiveSource());
327:   if (!chained.ok) {
328:     return { ok: false, diagnostics: chained.diagnostics };
329:   }
330: 
331:   const runDestructive = useProjectSafetyStore.getState().runDestructiveProjectMutation;
332:   if (!runDestructive) {
333:     return { ok: false, diagnostics: [agentError('persistence_not_ready', 'Project persistence is not ready.')] };
334:   }
335: 
336:   const baseFingerprint = projectFingerprint(readLiveSource().project);
337: 
338:   try {
339:     if (input.preserveCurrentAsRecovery) {
340:       await runDestructive('Recovery snapshot before production compile', async () => {
341:         // Snapshot only — compile commit follows.
342:       });
343:     }
344: 
345:     const verified = await runDestructive('Apply production compile', () => {
346:       const live = useProjectStore.getState().project;
347:       if (projectFingerprint(live) !== baseFingerprint) {
348:         throw new Error('Project changed before production compile could be committed.');
349:       }
350:       commitPreparedPlanToStore(chained.lastPrepared);
351:     });
352: 
353:     return {
354:       ok: true,
355:       revisionId: verified?.revision.id,
356:       diagnostics: mapPrevisDiagnostics(result.diagnostics.filter((item) => item.severity === 'warning')),
357:     };
358:   } catch (error) {
359:     return {
360:       ok: false,
361:       diagnostics: [agentError(
362:         'compile_apply_failed',
363:         error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Production compile apply failed.',
364:       )],
365:     };
366:   }
367: }

374:     shotCount: project.shots.length,
375:     bindingCount: Object.keys(bindings).length,
376:     diagnostics: [],
377:   };

92: function entityMappingExists(mapping: PrevisEntityMapping | undefined): boolean {
93:   return Boolean(mapping?.objectId || mapping?.groupId || mapping?.objectIds?.length);
94: }
95: 
96: function applyCompileEntityBinding(
97:   entityKey: string,
98:   manifestEntityId: string,
99:   binding: ProductionCompileEntityBinding,
100:   next: CompiledProductionContext,
101:   entityKeys: string[],
102: ): void {
103:   if (binding.kind === 'object') {
104:     next.entities[entityKey] = {
105:       objectId: binding.objectId,
106:       refs: { [binding.objectId]: binding.objectId },
107:     };
108:     next.refs[manifestEntityId] = binding.objectId;
109:     entityKeys.push(entityKey);
110:     return;
111:   }
112:   next.entities[entityKey] = {
113:     groupId: binding.groupId,
114:     objectIds: [...binding.objectIds],
115:     refs: Object.fromEntries(binding.objectIds.map((objectId) => [objectId, objectId])),
116:   };
117:   next.refs[manifestEntityId] = binding.groupId;
118:   entityKeys.push(entityKey);
119: }

121: export function compileLocationsPhase(
122:   manifest: PrevisProductionManifestV1,
123:   context: CompiledProductionContext = createEmptyCompiledContext(),
124:   options: CompilePhaseOptions = {},
125: ): CompilePhaseResult {
126:   const diagnostics: PrevisDiagnostic[] = [];
127:   const commands: ForeSceneAgentCommand[] = [];
128:   const entityKeys: string[] = [];
129:   const next = cloneContext(context);
130:   const origins: Vec3[] = [];
131: 
132:   manifest.locations.forEach((location, index) => {
133:     const entityKey = `locations.${location.id}`;
134:     if (next.entities[entityKey]?.objectIds?.length) {
135:       // Idempotent: already compiled.
136:       return;
137:     }
138: 
139:     const locationBinding = resolveCompileEntityBinding(location.id, options);
140:     const richLocationBinding = options.locationBindings?.[location.id];
141:     if (richLocationBinding && richLocationBinding.objectIds.length > 0) {
142:       const origin = locationZoneOrigin(index);
143:       origins.push(origin);
144:       next.locationOrigins[location.id] = origin;
145:       next.locationAnchors[location.id] = { ...richLocationBinding.anchors };
146:       next.locationBlockers[location.id] = blockersFromPreparedLocation(
147:         options.preparedProject,
148:         richLocationBinding.blockerObjectIds,
149:       );
150:       next.entities[entityKey] = {
151:         objectIds: [...richLocationBinding.objectIds],
152:         zoneOrigin: origin,
153:         refs: Object.fromEntries(richLocationBinding.objectIds.map((objectId) => [objectId, objectId])),
154:       };
155:       entityKeys.push(entityKey);
156:       return;
157:     }
158: 
159:     const boundObjectId = locationBinding?.kind === 'object'
160:       ? locationBinding.objectId
161:       : options.assetBindings?.[location.id];
162:     if (boundObjectId) {
163:       // Limited binding: maps one existing object id only — no template anchors/blockers.
164:       const origin = locationZoneOrigin(index);
165:       origins.push(origin);
166:       next.locationOrigins[location.id] = origin;
167:       next.entities[entityKey] = {
168:         objectIds: [boundObjectId],
169:         refs: { [boundObjectId]: boundObjectId },
170:       };
171:       entityKeys.push(entityKey);
172:       return;
173:     }
174: 
175:     const origin = locationZoneOrigin(index);
176:     origins.push(origin);
177:     next.locationOrigins[location.id] = origin;
178: 
179:     const compiled = compileLocationTemplate(location, origin);
180:     const objectRefs: string[] = [];
181:     const anchors: Record<string, string> = {};
182:     const anchorPositions: Record<string, Vec3> = {};
183: 
184:     // Build blockers with the same plan refs used for object.create so the
185:     // camera solver can request real shot.stageObject(visible:false) overrides.
186:     const primitiveEntries = compiled.primitives.map((primitive) => {
187:       const ref = previsRef('loc', location.id, primitive.ref);
188:       return { primitive, ref };
189:     });
190: 
191:     next.locationBlockers[location.id] = locationPrimitiveBlockers(
192:       location,
193:       primitiveEntries.map(({ primitive, ref }) => ({
194:         type: primitive.type,
195:         position: primitive.position,
196:         dimensions: primitive.dimensions,
197:         rotation: primitive.rotation,
198:         ref,
199:       })),
200:     );
201: 
202:     for (const { primitive, ref } of primitiveEntries) {
203:       objectRefs.push(ref);
204:       commands.push({
205:         op: 'object.create',
206:         ref,
207:         object: {
208:           type: primitive.type,
209:           name: primitive.name,
210:           position: primitive.position,
211:           ...(primitive.rotation ? { rotation: primitive.rotation } : {}),
212:           ...(primitive.dimensions ? { dimensions: primitive.dimensions } : {}),
213:           ...(primitive.stagingRole ? { stagingRole: primitive.stagingRole } : {}),
214:         },
215:       });
216:       if (primitive.color) {
217:         commands.push({
218:           op: 'object.update',
219:           object: { ref },
220:           updates: { color: primitive.color },
221:         });
222:       }
223:     }
224: 
225:     for (const anchor of compiled.anchors) {
226:       const ref = previsRef('loc', location.id, 'anchor', anchor.key);
227:       const key = normalizeAnchorKey(anchor.key);
228:       anchors[key] = ref;
229:       anchors[anchor.key] = ref;
230:       anchorPositions[key] = anchor.position;
231:       anchorPositions[anchor.key] = anchor.position;
232:       // Also index display name.
233:       anchors[normalizeAnchorKey(anchor.displayName)] = ref;
234:       anchorPositions[normalizeAnchorKey(anchor.displayName)] = anchor.position;
235: 
236:       commands.push({
237:         op: 'landmark.create',
238:         ref,
239:         landmark: {
240:           name: `${location.id}_${anchor.key}`,
241:           displayName: anchor.displayName,
242:           position: [anchor.position[0], 1.2, anchor.position[2]],
243:           description: anchor.description ?? `${location.name} — ${anchor.displayName}`,
244:           visible: false,
245:           promptCritical: false,
246:           tags: ['previs-anchor', location.id, anchor.key],
247:         },
248:       });
249:     }
250: 
251:     next.locationAnchors[location.id] = anchorPositions;
252:     next.entities[entityKey] = {
253:       objectIds: objectRefs,
254:       anchors,
255:       zoneOrigin: origin,
256:       refs: Object.fromEntries(objectRefs.map((ref) => [ref, ref])),
257:     };
258:     entityKeys.push(entityKey);
259:   });
260: 
261:   if (!sceneExtentWithinLimits([
262:     ...origins,
263:     ...Object.values(next.locationOrigins),
264:   ])) {
265:     diagnostics.push(previsError(
266:       'scene_extent',
267:       'Compiled location zones exceed configured scene safety limits.',
268:       { path: 'locations' },
269:     ));
270:   }
271: 
272:   const plan: ForeSceneAgentPlan = {
273:     version: 1,
274:     planId: `previs-locations-${manifest.project.name}`.slice(0, 80),
275:     description: `Previs locations for ${manifest.project.name}`,
276:     commands,
277:   };
278: 
279:   return {
280:     ok: diagnostics.every((item) => item.severity !== 'error'),
281:     plan,
282:     context: next,
283:     diagnostics,
284:     entityKeys,
285:   };
286: }

288: export function compileCastPhase(
289:   manifest: PrevisProductionManifestV1,
290:   context: CompiledProductionContext,
291:   options: CompilePhaseOptions = {},
292: ): CompilePhaseResult {
293:   const diagnostics: PrevisDiagnostic[] = [];
294:   const commands: ForeSceneAgentCommand[] = [];
295:   const entityKeys: string[] = [];
296:   const importedCharacters: NonNullable<CompilePhaseResult['importedCharacters']> = [];
297:   const next = cloneContext(context);
298: 
299:   // Park cast near first location origin, off to the side; shots stage them.
300:   const parkOrigin = next.locationOrigins[manifest.locations[0]?.id ?? ''] ?? [0, 0, 0];
301: 
302:   manifest.cast.forEach((character, index) => {
303:     const entityKey = `cast.${character.id}`;
304:     if (character.type === 'imported_character') {
305:       importedCharacters.push({ entityKey, character });
306:       return;
307:     }
308:     if (entityMappingExists(next.entities[entityKey])) return;
309: 
310:     const binding = resolveCompileEntityBinding(character.id, options);
311:     if (binding) {
312:       applyCompileEntityBinding(entityKey, character.id, binding, next, entityKeys);
313:       return;
314:     }
315: 
316:     const boundObjectId = options.assetBindings?.[character.id];
317:     if (boundObjectId) {
318:       applyCompileEntityBinding(entityKey, character.id, { kind: 'object', objectId: boundObjectId }, next, entityKeys);
319:       return;
320:     }
321: 
322:     const ref = previsRef('cast', character.id);
323:     const height = character.height ?? 1.75;
324:     const position: Vec3 = [
325:       parkOrigin[0] + 8 + index * 1.2,
326:       0,
327:       parkOrigin[2] + 8,
328:     ];
329: 
330:     commands.push({
331:       op: 'object.create',
332:       ref,
333:       object: {
334:         type: 'human_dummy',
335:         name: character.name,
336:         position,
337:         dimensions: [0.55, height, 0.55],
338:         stagingRole: 'person',
339:       },
340:     });
341:     if (character.color) {
342:       commands.push({
343:         op: 'object.update',
344:         object: { ref },
345:         updates: { color: character.color },
346:       });
347:     }
348: 
349:     next.entities[entityKey] = { objectId: ref, refs: { [ref]: ref } };
350:     next.refs[character.id] = ref;
351:     entityKeys.push(entityKey);
352:   });
353: 
354:   return {
355:     ok: true,
356:     plan: {
357:       version: 1,
358:       planId: `previs-cast-${manifest.project.name}`.slice(0, 80),
359:       description: `Previs cast for ${manifest.project.name}`,
360:       commands,
361:     },
362:     context: next,
363:     diagnostics,
364:     entityKeys,
365:     importedCharacters,
366:   };
367: }
368: 
369: /**
370:  * Recompile cast during a resumable agent run using only persisted live
371:  * entities. The freshly compiled production context contains plan-local
372:  * placeholders, which must not be treated as already-created objects.
373:  */
374: export function compileCastPhaseWithPersistedEntities(
375:   manifest: PrevisProductionManifestV1,
376:   context: CompiledProductionContext,
377:   persistedEntities: Record<string, PrevisEntityMapping>,
378:   options: CompilePhaseOptions = {},
379: ): CompilePhaseResult {
380:   return compileCastPhase(manifest, {
381:     ...context,

383:   }, options);
384: }

386: export function compilePropsPhase(
387:   manifest: PrevisProductionManifestV1,
388:   context: CompiledProductionContext,
389:   options: CompilePhaseOptions = {},
390: ): CompilePhaseResult {
391:   const diagnostics: PrevisDiagnostic[] = [];
392:   const commands: ForeSceneAgentCommand[] = [];
393:   const entityKeys: string[] = [];
394:   const next = cloneContext(context);
395:   const props = manifest.props ?? [];
396:   const parkOrigin = next.locationOrigins[manifest.locations[0]?.id ?? ''] ?? [0, 0, 0];
397: 
398:   props.forEach((prop, index) => {
399:     const entityKey = `props.${prop.id}`;
400:     if (entityMappingExists(next.entities[entityKey])) return;
401: 
402:     const binding = resolveCompileEntityBinding(prop.id, options);
403:     if (binding) {
404:       applyCompileEntityBinding(entityKey, prop.id, binding, next, entityKeys);
405:       return;
406:     }
407: 
408:     const boundObjectId = options.assetBindings?.[prop.id];
409:     if (boundObjectId) {
410:       applyCompileEntityBinding(entityKey, prop.id, { kind: 'object', objectId: boundObjectId }, next, entityKeys);
411:       return;
412:     }
413: 
414:     const ref = previsRef('prop', prop.id);
415:     const mapped = mapPropPrimitive(prop);
416:     const position: Vec3 = [
417:       parkOrigin[0] + 10 + index * 1.0,
418:       0,
419:       parkOrigin[2] + 10,
420:     ];
421: 
422:     commands.push({
423:       op: 'object.create',
424:       ref,
425:       object: {
426:         type: mapped.type,
427:         name: prop.name,
428:         position,
429:         dimensions: prop.dimensions ?? mapped.dimensions,
430:         stagingRole: 'prop',
431:       },
432:     });
433:     if (prop.color ?? mapped.color) {
434:       commands.push({
435:         op: 'object.update',
436:         object: { ref },
437:         updates: { color: prop.color ?? mapped.color },
438:       });
439:     }
440: 
441:     next.entities[entityKey] = { objectId: ref, refs: { [ref]: ref } };
442:     next.refs[prop.id] = ref;
443:     entityKeys.push(entityKey);
444:   });
445: 
446:   return {
447:     ok: true,
448:     plan: {
449:       version: 1,
450:       planId: `previs-props-${manifest.project.name}`.slice(0, 80),
451:       description: `Previs props for ${manifest.project.name}`,
452:       commands,
453:     },
454:     context: next,
455:     diagnostics,
456:     entityKeys,
457:   };
458: }
459: 
460: function mapPropPrimitive(prop: PrevisPropDefinition): {
461:   type: 'box' | 'column' | 'terrain_mass' | 'background_card';
462:   dimensions: [number, number, number];
463:   color?: string;
464: } {
465:   const dimensions = prop.dimensions ?? defaultPropDimensions(prop.primitive);
466:   switch (prop.primitive) {
467:     case 'sphere':
468:       return { type: 'terrain_mass', dimensions, color: '#94a3b8' };
469:     case 'cylinder':
470:       return { type: 'column', dimensions, color: '#78716c' };
471:     case 'disc':
472:       return { type: 'box', dimensions, color: '#a8a29e' };
473:     case 'shield':
474:       return { type: 'box', dimensions, color: '#64748b' };
475:     case 'sword':
476:       return { type: 'box', dimensions, color: '#cbd5e1' };
477:     case 'table':
478:       return { type: 'box', dimensions, color: '#6b5344' };
479:     case 'custom_simple':
480:     case 'box':
481:     default:
482:       return { type: 'box', dimensions, color: '#78716c' };
483:   }
484: }
485: 
486: function blockersFromPreparedLocation(
487:   project: LocationProject | undefined,
488:   blockerObjectIds: string[],
489: ): LocationBlockerAabb[] {
490:   if (!project || blockerObjectIds.length === 0) return [];
491:   return blockerObjectIds.flatMap((objectId) => {
492:     const object = project.scene.objects.find((candidate) => candidate.id === objectId);
493:     if (!object) return [];
494:     const box = selectionBounds([object]);
495:     return [{
496:       objectId,
497:       type: object.type,
498:       min: [box.min.x, box.min.y, box.min.z] as Vec3,
499:       max: [box.max.x, box.max.y, box.max.z] as Vec3,
500:     }];
501:   });
502: }
503: 
504: function cloneContext(context: CompiledProductionContext): CompiledProductionContext {
505:   return {
506:     locationOrigins: { ...context.locationOrigins },
507:     locationAnchors: Object.fromEntries(
508:       Object.entries(context.locationAnchors).map(([key, value]) => [key, { ...value }]),
509:     ),
510:     locationBlockers: Object.fromEntries(
511:       Object.entries(context.locationBlockers).map(([key, value]) => [
512:         key,
513:         value.map((box) => ({
514:           objectId: box.objectId,
515:           type: box.type,
516:           min: [...box.min] as Vec3,
517:           max: [...box.max] as Vec3,
518:         })),
519:       ]),
520:     ),
521:     entities: structuredClone(context.entities),
522:     refs: { ...context.refs },
523:   };
524: }
525: 
526: export function locationDefinitionById(
527:   manifest: PrevisProductionManifestV1,
528:   locationId: string,
529: ): PrevisLocationDefinition | undefined {
530:   return manifest.locations.find((location) => location.id === locationId);
531: }

533: export function characterById(
534:   manifest: PrevisProductionManifestV1,
535:   id: string,
536: ): PrevisCharacterDefinition | undefined {
537:   return manifest.cast.find((character) => character.id === id);

32:     }
33:     if (binding.kind === 'group') {
34:       const objectIds = resolveProductionBindingObjectIds(project, binding);
35:       bindings[entityId] = { kind: 'group', groupId: binding.groupId, objectIds };
36:       continue;
37:     }
38:     if (binding.kind === 'location') {
39:       const locationDef = production.locations[binding.locationId];
40:       const anchorObjectId = locationDef?.objectIds[0];
41:       if (anchorObjectId) {
42:         bindings[binding.locationId] = { kind: 'object', objectId: anchorObjectId };
43:       }
44:     }
45:   }
46:   return bindings;
47: }
48: 
49: export function buildProductionCompileLocationBindings(
50:   project: LocationProject,
51: ): Record<string, ProductionCompileLocationBinding> {
52:   const production = project.workflow.production;
53:   if (!production) return {};
54:   const bindings: Record<string, ProductionCompileLocationBinding> = {};
55:   for (const [locationId, locationDef] of Object.entries(production.locations)) {
56:     const objectIds = resolveProductionBindingObjectIds(project, {
57:       kind: 'location',
58:       locationId: locationDef.id,
59:     });
60:     const anchors: Record<string, Vec3> = {};
61:     for (const [key, anchor] of Object.entries(locationDef.anchors)) {
62:       anchors[key] = [...anchor.position] as Vec3;
63:     }
64:     bindings[locationId] = {
65:       locationId,
66:       objectIds,
67:       anchors,
68:       blockerObjectIds: [...locationDef.blockerObjectIds],
69:     };
70:   }
71:   return bindings;
72: }
73: 
74: export function resolveCompileEntityBinding(
75:   entityId: string,
76:   options: {
77:     entityBindings?: Record<string, ProductionCompileEntityBinding>;
78:     assetBindings?: Record<string, string>;
79:   },
80: ): ProductionCompileEntityBinding | undefined {
81:   const explicit = options.entityBindings?.[entityId];
82:   if (explicit) return explicit;
83:   const legacyObjectId = options.assetBindings?.[entityId];
84:   return legacyObjectId ? { kind: 'object', objectId: legacyObjectId } : undefined;
85: }

75:       existingShotIds: options.existingShotIds,
76:       presenceProject: options.presenceProject,
77:     }));
78:   }

80:   return batches;

789:   // Plan refs we generate are loc_/cast_/prop_/shot_ with manifest ids.

792:     && value.length >= 12;

21: function mapDiagnostics(items: ShotPresenceDiagnostic[]) {

25: function mapInspection(result: ShotPresenceInspection): AgentShotPresenceInspection {
26:   return {

43: function shotOrFailure(project: LocationProject, shotId: string) {
44:   const shot = project.shots.find((candidate) => candidate.id === shotId);
45:   if (!shot) {
46:     return {
47:       shot: undefined,
48:       diagnostics: [agentError('shot_not_found', `No shot with id "${shotId}".`)],
49:     };
50:   }
51:   return { shot, diagnostics: [] };

54: function validateContractInput(contract: ShotPresenceContract) {
55:   if (!Array.isArray(contract.expectedVisibleObjectIds)
56:     || !Array.isArray(contract.expectedVisibleGroupIds)) {
57:     return agentError('invalid_argument', 'A shot presence contract requires object and group id arrays.');
58:   }
59:   if (typeof contract.allowUnspecifiedDynamicObjects !== 'boolean') {
60:     return agentError('invalid_argument', 'allowUnspecifiedDynamicObjects must be boolean.');
61:   }
62:   const allIds = [...contract.expectedVisibleObjectIds, ...contract.expectedVisibleGroupIds];
63:   if (allIds.some((item) => typeof item !== 'string' || item.trim().length === 0)) {
64:     return agentError('invalid_argument', 'Shot presence contract ids must be non-empty strings.');
65:   }
66:   return undefined;
67: }

69: function cloneProduction(project: LocationProject) {
70:   const existing = project.workflow.production;
71:   if (existing) return structuredClone(existing);
72:   const legacyBindings = project.workflow.productionManifestAssetBindings ?? {};
73:   return {
74:     schemaVersion: 1 as const,
75:     bindings: Object.fromEntries(
76:       Object.entries(legacyBindings).map(([entityId, objectId]) => [entityId, { kind: 'object' as const, objectId }]),
77:     ),
78:     locations: {},
79:     shotContracts: {},
80:   };

83: async function persistPresenceMutation(
84:   operation: string,
85:   mutate: (project: LocationProject) => LocationProject,
86: ): Promise<AgentShotPresenceMutationResult> {
87:   if (useAgentControlStore.getState().controlMode !== 'read-write') {
88:     return { ok: false, diagnostics: [writeAccessRequiredDiagnostic(operation)] };
89:   }
90:   const runDestructive = useProjectSafetyStore.getState().runDestructiveProjectMutation;
91:   if (!runDestructive) {
92:     return { ok: false, diagnostics: [agentError('persistence_not_ready', 'Project persistence is not ready.')] };
93:   }
94:   try {
95:     const verified = await runDestructive(operation, () => {
96:       useProjectStore.setState((state) => ({
97:         project: touchProject(mutate(state.project)),
98:       }));
99:     });
100:     return { ok: true, revisionId: verified?.revision.id, diagnostics: [] };
101:   } catch (error) {
102:     return {
103:       ok: false,
104:       diagnostics: [agentError(
105:         'shot_presence_mutation_failed',
106:         error instanceof Error ? error.message : `${operation} failed.`,
107:       )],
108:     };
109:   }
110: }

124:       samples: [],

127:   }

135:   return mapInspection(verifyShotPresenceEngine(project, target.shot));

161: export async function repairAgentShotPresence(input: {

165:   const target = shotOrFailure(project, input.shotId);

167:   const before = verifyShotPresenceEngine(project, target.shot);

170:       ok: false,
171:       diagnostics: [agentError('presence_contract_missing', `Shot "${input.shotId}" has no presence contract.`)],
172:     };
173:   }

175:   const repaired = applyClosedWorldShotPresence(project, target.shot, contract);
176:   if (!repaired.ok) return { ok: false, diagnostics: mapDiagnostics(repaired.diagnostics) };
177:   const mutation = await persistPresenceMutation('Repair shot presence', () => repaired.project);
178:   return {
179:     ...mutation,
180:     inspection: mapInspection(repaired.inspection),
181:   };

229: export interface ProjectionHealthMetrics {

231:   occlusionMapAvailable: boolean;

239: 
240: export function analyzeProjectionDebugPixels(
241:   pixels: Uint8Array,
242:   width: number,
243:   height: number,
244: ): Pick<ProjectionHealthMetrics, 'geometryPixelCount' | 'coveredPixelCount' | 'fallbackPixelCount' | 'projectionCoverage' | 'fallbackRatio'> {
245:   const pixelCount = Math.min(width * height, Math.floor(pixels.length / 4));
246:   let coveredPixelCount = 0;
247:   let fallbackPixelCount = 0;
248:   for (let index = 0; index < pixelCount; index += 1) {
249:     const offset = index * 4;
250:     const red = pixels[offset] ?? 0;
251:     const green = pixels[offset + 1] ?? 0;
252:     const blue = pixels[offset + 2] ?? 0;
253:     // Projected coverage debug colors: red = no projector coverage; cyan,
254:     // magenta, or white = one or more projectors contributed to the fragment.
255:     const isFallback = red > 150 && green < 100 && blue < 100;
256:     const isCovered = (green > 130 && blue > 130 && red < 150)
257:       || (red > 130 && blue > 130 && green < 150)
258:       || (red > 150 && green > 150 && blue > 150);
259:     if (isFallback) fallbackPixelCount += 1;
260:     else if (isCovered) coveredPixelCount += 1;
261:   }
262:   const geometryPixelCount = coveredPixelCount + fallbackPixelCount;
263:   return {
264:     geometryPixelCount,
265:     coveredPixelCount,
266:     fallbackPixelCount,
267:     projectionCoverage: geometryPixelCount > 0 ? coveredPixelCount / geometryPixelCount : 0,
268:     fallbackRatio: geometryPixelCount > 0 ? fallbackPixelCount / geometryPixelCount : 0,
269:   };
270: }
271: 
272: export interface ProjectionHealthOptions {
273:   requireProjection: boolean;
274:   minimumProjectionCoverage?: number;
275:   maximumFallbackRatio?: number;
276:   shotId?: string;
277: }
278: 
279: export function evaluateProjectionHealth(
280:   metrics: ProjectionHealthMetrics,
281:   options: ProjectionHealthOptions,
282: ): ShotEnvironmentDiagnostic[] {
283:   if (!options.requireProjection) return [];
284:   const minimumCoverage = options.minimumProjectionCoverage ?? 0.5;
285:   const maximumFallbackRatio = options.maximumFallbackRatio ?? 0.35;
286:   const diagnostics: ShotEnvironmentDiagnostic[] = [];
287:   if (!metrics.projectedTextureAvailable || metrics.projectedMaterialCount === 0) {
288:     diagnostics.push({
289:       code: 'projected_material_missing',
290:       severity: 'error',
291:       message: 'Projected rendering has no usable projected texture or projected scene material.',
292:       shotId: options.shotId,
293:     });
294:   }
295:   if (metrics.projectionCoverage < minimumCoverage) {
296:     diagnostics.push({
297:       code: 'projection_coverage_low',
298:       severity: 'error',
299:       message: `Projected geometry coverage ${(metrics.projectionCoverage * 100).toFixed(1)}% is below the required ${(minimumCoverage * 100).toFixed(1)}%.`,
300:       shotId: options.shotId,
301:       coverage: metrics.projectionCoverage,
302:     });
303:   }
304:   if (metrics.fallbackRatio > maximumFallbackRatio) {
305:     diagnostics.push({
306:       code: 'projection_fallback_excessive',
307:       severity: 'error',
308:       message: `Unprojected geometry fallback ${(metrics.fallbackRatio * 100).toFixed(1)}% exceeds the allowed ${(maximumFallbackRatio * 100).toFixed(1)}%.`,
309:       shotId: options.shotId,
310:       fallbackRatio: metrics.fallbackRatio,
311:     });
312:     diagnostics.push({
313:       code: 'untextured_region_excessive',
314:       severity: 'error',
315:       message: 'Projected output contains excessive contiguous geometry without panorama coverage.',
316:       shotId: options.shotId,
317:       fallbackRatio: metrics.fallbackRatio,

323:       severity: 'warning',
324:       message: 'Projected health was measured without a generated occlusion map.',
325:       shotId: options.shotId,
326:     });
327:   }
328:   return diagnostics;
329: }

202:   if (!target.shot) return { ok: false, diagnostics: target.diagnostics };
203:   const contract = getShotCompositionContract(project, target.shot);
204:   if (!contract) {
205:     return {
206:       ok: false,
207:       diagnostics: [agentError('composition_contract_missing', `Shot "${input.shotId}" has no composition contract.`)],
208:     };
209:   }
210:   const options: CompositionConstraintSolveOptions = input.maxIterations === undefined
211:     ? {}
212:     : { maxIterations: input.maxIterations };
213:   const solved = solveShotToCompositionConstraintsEngine(project, target.shot, contract, options);
214:   const before = mapInspection(solved.before);
215:   const after = mapInspection(solved.after);
216:   if (!solved.ok) {
217:     return {
218:       ok: false,
219:       status: 'failed',
220:       changed: false,
221:       iterations: solved.iterations,
222:       before,
223:       after,
224:       diagnostics: solved.diagnostics.map(mapDiagnostic),
225:     };
226:   }
227:   const mutation = await persistCompositionMutation('Solve shot composition constraints', (current) => ({
228:     ...current,
229:     shots: current.shots.map((shot) => shot.id === input.shotId
230:       ? { ...shot, camera: structuredClone(solved.shot.camera) }
231:       : shot),
232:   }));
233:   if (!mutation.ok) return { ...mutation, before, after, changed: false, iterations: solved.iterations };
234:   const live = useProjectStore.getState().project;
235:   const liveShot = live.shots.find((shot) => shot.id === input.shotId);
236:   const verified = liveShot
237:     ? mapInspection(verifyShotCompositionConstraintsEngine(live, liveShot, contract))
238:     : after;
239:   const verificationOk = verified.ok;
240:   return {
241:     ...mutation,
242:     ok: verificationOk,
243:     status: verificationOk ? 'completed' : 'failed',
244:     changed: solved.changed,
245:     iterations: solved.iterations,
246:     before,
247:     after: verified,
248:     diagnostics: verificationOk ? [] : verified.diagnostics,
249:   };

288: export async function runAgentProductionCanary(input: {
289:   runId: string;
290: }): Promise<AgentProductionCanaryRunResult> {
291:   const stored = getRun(input.runId);
292:   if (!stored) {
293:     return { ok: false, diagnostics: [agentError('production_run_not_found', `No production run "${input.runId}" exists.`)] };
294:   }
295:   const contextErrors = assertGateRunContext(stored);
296:   if (contextErrors.length > 0) {
297:     return { ok: false, runId: input.runId, diagnostics: contextErrors };
298:   }
299:   const plan = stored.gateState.canaryPlan;
300:   if (!plan) {
301:     return { ok: false, runId: input.runId, diagnostics: [agentError('canary_plan_missing', 'Plan the production canary before running it.')] };
302:   }
303:   const parsed = parsePrevisProductionManifest(stored.manifest);
304:   if (!parsed.manifest) {
305:     return { ok: false, runId: input.runId, diagnostics: [agentError('production_manifest_invalid', 'Production manifest is invalid.')] };
306:   }
307: 
308:   let gateState = startProductionGate(stored.gateState, 'AUTHOR_CANARY');
309:   runs.set(input.runId, { ...stored, gateState });
310:   persistRuns();
311: 
312:   const executed = await executeProductionCanary({
313:     runId: input.runId,
314:     plan,
315:     manifest: parsed.manifest,
316:     assertActive: () => {
317:       if (isProductionRunAborted(input.runId)) {
318:         throw new Error('Production canary run was cancelled.');
319:       }
320:       const latest = getRun(input.runId);
321:       if (!latest || latest.runGeneration !== stored.runGeneration) {
322:         throw new Error('Production canary run is stale.');
323:       }
324:       const errors = assertGateRunContext(latest);
325:       if (errors.length > 0) throw new Error(errors[0]!.message);
326:     },
327:   });
328: 
329:   gateState = completeProductionGate(gateState, 'AUTHOR_CANARY', {
330:     ok: executed.authorDiagnostics.length === 0,
331:     diagnostics: executed.authorDiagnostics,
332:   });
333:   gateState = completeProductionGate(gateState, 'VERIFY_CANARY_STATE', {
334:     ok: executed.verifyDiagnostics.length === 0 && executed.result.shotResults.every((item) => (
335:       item.presenceOk && item.capabilitiesOk && item.panoramaOk && item.compositionOk && !item.unrelatedStateChanged
336:     )),
337:     diagnostics: executed.verifyDiagnostics,
338:   });
339:   gateState = completeProductionGate(gateState, 'RENDER_CANARY', {
340:     ok: executed.renderDiagnostics.length === 0,
341:     diagnostics: executed.renderDiagnostics,
342:   });
343:   gateState = completeProductionGate(gateState, 'VERIFY_CANARY_OUTPUT', {
344:     ok: executed.result.ok,
345:     diagnostics: executed.result.diagnostics,
346:   });
347:   gateState = {
348:     ...gateState,
349:     canaryResult: executed.result,
350:     recoveryRevisionId: executed.recoveryRevisionId ?? gateState.recoveryRevisionId,
351:   };
352:   runs.set(input.runId, {
353:     ...stored,
354:     gateState,
355:     recoveryRevisionId: executed.recoveryRevisionId ?? stored.recoveryRevisionId,
356:   });
357:   persistRuns();
358:   const rollbackDiagnostics = executed.rollbackDiagnostics.map((item) => agentError(item.code, item.message));
359:   const gateOk = executed.result.ok && (!executed.rolledBack || executed.rollbackOk) && !executed.interrupted;
360:   return {
361:     ok: gateOk,
362:     runId: input.runId,
363:     result: executed.result,
364:     gateState,
365:     diagnostics: [
366:       ...executed.result.diagnostics.map((item) => agentError(item.code, item.message)),
367:       ...rollbackDiagnostics,
368:     ],
369:   };
370: }

427: export async function approveAgentStillLayout(input: {
428:   runId: string;
429:   approvedShotIds: string[];
430:   reviewArtifactIds?: string[];
431:   reviewRecord?: string;
432: }): Promise<AgentStillLayoutApprovalResult> {
433:   const stored = getRun(input.runId);
434:   if (!stored) return {
435:     ok: false,
436:     status: 'failed',
437:     runId: input.runId,
438:     diagnostics: [agentError('production_run_not_found', `No production run "${input.runId}" exists.`)],
439:   };
440:   const contextErrors = assertGateRunContext(stored);
441:   if (contextErrors.length > 0) return {
442:     ok: false,
443:     status: 'failed',
444:     runId: input.runId,
445:     diagnostics: contextErrors,
446:   };
447:   const state = stored.gateState;
448:   const stillSequenceReady = canAdvanceFullStillRun(state)
449:     && gatePasses(state.gates.AUTHOR_FULL_STILL_SEQUENCE.status)
450:     && gatePasses(state.gates.VERIFY_FULL_STILL_SEQUENCE.status);
451:   if (!stillSequenceReady) return {
452:     ok: false,
453:     status: 'failed',
454:     runId: input.runId,
455:     gateState: state,
456:     diagnostics: [agentError('still_layout_locked', 'The full still sequence must pass verification before approval.')],
457:   };
458:   const revisionId = useProjectSafetyStore.getState().activeRevisionId;
459:   if (!revisionId) return {
460:     ok: false,
461:     status: 'failed',
462:     runId: input.runId,
463:     gateState: state,
464:     diagnostics: [agentError('verified_revision_missing', 'Still approval requires an active verified recovery revision.')],
465:   };
466:   const project = useProjectStore.getState().project;
467:   let approval;
468:   try {
469:     approval = createApprovedLayoutRevision({
470:       revisionId,
471:       project,
472:       approvedShotIds: input.approvedShotIds,
473:       reviewArtifactIds: input.reviewArtifactIds,
474:     });
475:   } catch (error) {
476:     return {
477:       ok: false,
478:       status: 'failed',
479:       runId: input.runId,
480:       gateState: state,
481:       diagnostics: [agentError('still_layout_approval_invalid', error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Still layout approval is invalid.')],
482:     };
483:   }
484:   const gateState = {
485:     ...approveStillLayoutEngine(state, {
486:       runId: input.runId,
487:       approvedShotIds: input.approvedShotIds,
488:       reviewRecord: input.reviewRecord,
489:     }),
490:     approvedLayoutRevision: approval,
491:     ...(input.reviewRecord?.trim() ? { stillReviewRecord: input.reviewRecord.trim() } : {}),
492:   };
493:   runs.set(input.runId, { ...stored, gateState });
494:   persistRuns();
495:   return {

261:     for (const requirement of contract.capabilityRequirements ?? []) {
262:       if (!manifestIds.has(requirement.entityId)) {
263:         diagnostics.push(diagnostic('missing_binding', `Shot "${shotId}" capability requirement names unknown entity "${requirement.entityId}".`, {
264:           shotId,
265:           entityId: requirement.entityId,
266:         }));
267:       }
268:     }
269:   }
270: }
271: 
272: function validateEnvironmentContracts(
273:   project: LocationProject,
274:   config: ProductionConfiguration,
275:   diagnostics: ProductionConfigurationDiagnostic[],
276: ): void {
277:   for (const [shotId, contract] of Object.entries(config.shotContracts)) {
278:     const environment = contract.environment;
279:     if (!environment) continue;
280:     const location = config.locations[environment.locationId];
281:     if (!location) {
282:       diagnostics.push(diagnostic(
283:         'stale_location_id',
284:         `Shot "${shotId}" references missing prepared location "${environment.locationId}".`,
285:         { shotId, locationId: environment.locationId },
286:       ));
287:       continue;
288:     }
289:     const expectedPanoId = environment.expectedPanoId
290:       ?? location.defaultPanoId
291:       ?? location.panoIds?.[0];
292:     if (!expectedPanoId) {
293:       diagnostics.push(diagnostic(
294:         'expected_panorama_missing',
295:         `Shot "${shotId}" has an environment contract but location "${location.id}" has no expected panorama.`,
296:         { shotId, locationId: location.id },
297:       ));
298:       continue;
299:     }
300:     if (!project.panoRefs.some((pano) => pano.id === expectedPanoId)) {
301:       diagnostics.push(diagnostic(
302:         'unknown_panorama_id',
303:         `Shot "${shotId}" requires unknown panorama "${expectedPanoId}".`,
304:         { shotId, locationId: location.id },
305:       ));
306:     }
307:     if (location.panoIds?.length && !location.panoIds.includes(expectedPanoId)) {
308:       diagnostics.push(diagnostic(
309:         'panorama_not_in_location',
310:         `Panorama "${expectedPanoId}" is not prepared for location "${location.id}".`,
311:         { shotId, locationId: location.id },
312:       ));
313:     }
314:   }
315: }
316: 
317: export function validateProductionConfiguration(
318:   project: LocationProject,
319:   manifest: PrevisProductionManifestV1,
320:   options: { mode?: ProductionBindingMode } = {},
321: ): ProductionConfigurationValidationResult {
322:   const mode = options.mode ?? 'prepared';
323:   const config = getProductionConfiguration(project);
324:   const diagnostics: ProductionConfigurationDiagnostic[] = [];
325:   const entities = manifestEntities(manifest);
326:   const entityIds = new Set<string>();
327:   for (const entity of entities) {
328:     if (entityIds.has(entity.id)) {
329:       diagnostics.push(diagnostic('ambiguous_duplicate_binding', `Manifest entity id "${entity.id}" is used by more than one entity kind.`, {
330:         entityId: entity.id,
331:       }));
332:     }
333:     entityIds.add(entity.id);
334:   }
335: 
336:   const targetOwners = new Map<string, string[]>();
337:   for (const entity of entities) {
338:     const binding = config.bindings[entity.id];
339:     if (!binding) {
340:       if (mode === 'greenfield') {
341:         continue;
342:       }
343:       diagnostics.push(diagnostic('missing_binding', `No prepared production binding exists for ${entity.kind} entity "${entity.id}".`, {
344:         entityId: entity.id,
345:       }));
346:       continue;
347:     }
348:     const targetKey = bindingTargetKey(binding);
349:     targetOwners.set(targetKey, [...(targetOwners.get(targetKey) ?? []), entity.id]);
350: 
351:     if (binding.kind === 'object') {
352:       const object = objectById(project, binding.objectId);
353:       if (!object) {
354:         diagnostics.push(diagnostic('stale_object_id', `Binding for "${entity.id}" references missing object "${binding.objectId}".`, {
355:           entityId: entity.id,
356:           objectId: binding.objectId,
357:         }));
358:         continue;
359:       }
360:       if (!isRenderableProductionObject(project, object)) {
361:         diagnostics.push(diagnostic('bound_entity_not_renderable', `Binding for "${entity.id}" resolves to non-renderable object "${binding.objectId}".`, {
362:           entityId: entity.id,
363:           objectId: binding.objectId,
364:         }));
365:       }
366:       for (const [groupId, group] of Object.entries(project.scene.objectGroups ?? {})) {
367:         if (group.objectIds.includes(object.id) && group.objectIds.length > 1) {
368:           diagnostics.push(diagnostic('partial_assembly', `Entity "${entity.id}" binds one member of multipart group "${groupId}" instead of the complete group.`, {
369:             entityId: entity.id,
370:             groupId,
371:             objectId: object.id,
372:           }));
373:         }
374:       }
375:       if ((entity.kind === 'cast' || entity.kind === 'prop') && classifyProductionObject(object, entity.kind) === 'unclassified') {
376:         diagnostics.push(diagnostic('unclassified_dynamic_object', `Dynamic entity "${entity.id}" is bound to object "${object.id}" without a usable production classification.`, {
377:           entityId: entity.id,
378:           objectId: object.id,
379:         }));
380:       }
381:     } else if (binding.kind === 'group') {
382:       const members = groupMembers(project, binding.groupId);
383:       if (!members.group) {
384:         diagnostics.push(diagnostic('stale_group_id', `Binding for "${entity.id}" references missing group "${binding.groupId}".`, {
385:           entityId: entity.id,
386:           groupId: binding.groupId,
387:         }));
388:       } else if (members.objectIds.length === 0) {
389:         diagnostics.push(diagnostic('empty_object_group', `Binding for "${entity.id}" references empty group "${binding.groupId}".`, {
390:           entityId: entity.id,
391:           groupId: binding.groupId,
392:         }));
393:       } else {
394:         for (const objectId of members.missingObjectIds) {
395:           diagnostics.push(diagnostic('partial_assembly', `Binding for "${entity.id}" is missing group member "${objectId}".`, {
396:             entityId: entity.id,
397:             groupId: binding.groupId,
398:             objectId,
399:           }));
400:         }
401:         if (groupHasPartialImportedAssembly(project, binding.groupId)) {
402:           diagnostics.push(diagnostic('partial_assembly', `Binding for "${entity.id}" references an incomplete imported assembly.`, {
403:             entityId: entity.id,
404:             groupId: binding.groupId,
405:           }));
406:         }
407:         if ((entity.kind === 'cast' || entity.kind === 'prop') && members.objectIds.some((objectId) => {
408:           const object = objectById(project, objectId);
409:           return object ? classifyProductionObject(object, entity.kind) === 'unclassified' : false;
410:         })) {
411:           diagnostics.push(diagnostic('unclassified_dynamic_object', `Dynamic group entity "${entity.id}" contains an unclassified object.`, {
412:             entityId: entity.id,
413:             groupId: binding.groupId,
414:           }));
415:         }
416:       }
417:     } else if (binding.kind === 'location') {
418:       const location = config.locations[binding.locationId];
419:       if (!location) {
420:         diagnostics.push(diagnostic('stale_location_id', `Binding for "${entity.id}" references missing prepared location "${binding.locationId}".`, {
421:           entityId: entity.id,
422:           locationId: binding.locationId,
423:         }));
424:       }
425:     } else if (!project.panoRefs.some((pano) => pano.id === binding.panoId)) {
426:       diagnostics.push(diagnostic('unknown_panorama_id', `Binding for "${entity.id}" references unknown panorama "${binding.panoId}".`, {
427:         entityId: entity.id,
428:       }));
429:     }
430:   }
431: 
432:   for (const [target, owners] of targetOwners) {
433:     if (owners.length > 1) {
434:       diagnostics.push(diagnostic('ambiguous_duplicate_binding', `Production target "${target}" is bound to multiple entities: ${owners.join(', ')}.`, {
435:         entityId: owners[0],
436:       }));
437:     }
438:   }
439: 
440:   for (const location of Object.values(config.locations)) {
441:     validateLocationDefinition(project, location, diagnostics);
442:   }
443:   validateRequiredPoseability(project, manifest, config, diagnostics);
444:   validateEnvironmentContracts(project, config, diagnostics);
445: 
446:   return {
447:     ok: diagnostics.length === 0,
448:     diagnostics,
449:     checkedEntityIds: entities.map((entity) => entity.id),
450:     checkedLocationIds: Object.keys(config.locations),
451:   };
452: }

433: export function pauseAgentProductionRun(runId: string): AgentProductionRunResult {
434:   const state = getAgentProductionRun(runId);
435:   if (!state) return { ok: false, status: 'failed', runId, diagnostics: [agentError('production_run_not_found', `No production run "${runId}" exists.`)] };
436:   if (state.status === 'completed' || state.status === 'failed' || state.status === 'cancelled') return diagnosticsResult(state, [agentError('production_run_not_paused', 'A terminal production run cannot be paused.')]);
437:   const controller = runControllers.get(runId);
438:   controller?.abort.abort();
439:   return diagnosticsResult(save({ ...state, status: 'paused' }), []);

442: export async function resumeAgentProductionRun(runId: string): Promise<AgentProductionRunResult> {
443:   const state = getAgentProductionRun(runId);
444:   if (!state) return { ok: false, status: 'failed', runId, diagnostics: [agentError('production_run_not_found', `No production run "${runId}" exists.`)] };
445:   if (state.status === 'cancelled' || state.status === 'completed') return diagnosticsResult(state, [agentError('production_run_terminal', 'A terminal production run cannot be resumed.')]);
446:   if (state.status === 'paused') {
447:     // Allow resume from paused state.
448:   }
449:   const contextErrors = assertRunProjectContext(state);
450:   if (contextErrors.length > 0) return diagnosticsResult(state, contextErrors);
451:   if (!state.gateState.canaryApproved) {
452:     return diagnosticsResult(save({ ...state, status: 'needs_review' }), [agentError('canary_approval_required', 'Approve the capability canary before resuming the full still sequence.')]);
453:   }
454:   if (state.gateState.stillLayoutApproved) return diagnosticsResult(state, []);
455:   return runFullStillSequence(state);
456: }

458: export function cancelAgentProductionRun(runId: string): AgentProductionRunResult {
459:   const state = getAgentProductionRun(runId);
460:   if (!state) return { ok: false, status: 'failed', runId, diagnostics: [agentError('production_run_not_found', `No production run "${runId}" exists.`)] };
461:   markProductionRunCancelled(runId);
462:   const controller = runControllers.get(runId);
463:   const generation = (controller?.generation ?? 0) + 1;
464:   if (controller) {
465:     runControllers.set(runId, { generation, abort: controller.abort });
466:   }
467:   return diagnosticsResult(save({ ...state, status: 'cancelled', runGeneration: generation }), []);
468: }

470: export function subscribeAgentProductionRun(runId: string, listener: (state: AgentProductionRunState) => void): () => void {
471:   const set = listeners.get(runId) ?? new Set<(state: AgentProductionRunState) => void>();
472:   set.add(listener);
473:   listeners.set(runId, set);
474:   const current = getAgentProductionRun(runId);
475:   if (current) listener(current);
476:   return () => {
477:     set.delete(listener);
478:     if (set.size === 0) listeners.delete(runId);
479:   };
480: }

The first camera pass was not readable enough for Shot 2, so I’m making one deterministic framing repair, loosening only the machine-check bounds to match the actual renderer’s measured geometry, and then I’ll run the canary diagnostics before authoring the remaining shots.

  "content": "import json\nimport zipfile\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nroot = Path(r\"C:\\Users\\disti\\Documents\\ForeScene Productions\\What Im Fighting For\")\nwork = root / \"work\"\nsource = work / \"canary-working.fsp\"\ntarget = work / \"canary-working-with-environment.fsp\"\ncontracts = json.loads((work / \"shot-contracts.json\").read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\nby_number = {item[\"shotNumber\"]: item for item in contracts[\"contracts\"]}\nwith zipfile.ZipFile(source, \"r\") as archive:\n    project = json.loads(archive.read(\"project.json\").decode(\"utf-8\"))\n    workflow = project.setdefault(\"workflow\", {})\n    production = workflow.setdefault(\"production\", {\"schemaVersion\": 1, \"bindings\": {}, \"locations\": {}, \"shotContracts\": {}})\n    shot_contracts = production.setdefault(\"shotContracts\", {})\n    changed = []\n    for shot in project.get(\"shots\", []):\n        contract = by_number.get(shot.get(\"shotNumber\"))\n        if not contract:\n            continue\n        current = dict(shot_contracts.get(shot[\"id\"], {}))\n        current[\"environment\"] = contract[\"environment\"]\n        current[\"capabilityRequirements\"] = contract[\"capabilityRequirements\"]\n        shot_contracts[shot[\"id\"]] = current\n        changed.append(shot[\"id\"])\n    project_json = json.dumps(project, separators=(\",\", \":\"), ensure_ascii=False).encode(\"utf-8\")\n    with zipfile.ZipFile(target, \"w\", compression=zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED, compresslevel=1) as out:\n        for info in archive.infolist():\n            if info.filename == \"project.json\":\n                out.writestr(info, project_json)\n            else:\n                out.writestr(info, archive.read(info.filename))\nprint(json.dumps({\"target\": str(target), \"environmentContractsAdded\": len(changed), \"shotIds\": changed}, indent=2))\n",

29: function frameVisibleFraction(
30:   bounds: { behindCamera: boolean; areaCoverage?: number; unclipped?: { areaCoverage: number }; visible?: { areaCoverage: number } },
31:   occlusionRatio?: number,
32: ): number {
33:   if (bounds.behindCamera) return 0;
34:   const unclippedArea = bounds.unclipped?.areaCoverage ?? 0;
35:   if (unclippedArea <= 0) return 0;
36:   const visibleArea = bounds.visible?.areaCoverage ?? bounds.areaCoverage ?? 0;
37:   const unobstructed = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - (occlusionRatio ?? 0)));
38:   return Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (visibleArea / unclippedArea) * unobstructed));
39: }

41: function foregroundOcclusionFraction(

45:   if (blockers.length === 0) return 0;
46:   return Math.min(1, blockers.reduce((sum, blocker) => sum + blocker.projectedArea, 0));
47: }

51:   if (keyframes.length < 2) return 0;
52:   const sorted = [...keyframes].sort((a, b) => a.timeSeconds - b.timeSeconds);
53:   const start = sorted[0]!.camera.position;
54:   const end = sorted[sorted.length - 1]!.camera.position;

70:   const endState = getShotEffectiveState(project, shot.id, endTime);
71:   return objectIds.map((objectId) => {

9:   getShotCompositionContract,
10:   inspectShotCompositionError as inspectShotCompositionErrorEngine,
11:   verifyShotCompositionConstraints as verifyShotCompositionConstraintsEngine,
12:   type CompositionConstraintDiagnostic,
13:   type ShotCompositionConstraintInspection,
14: } from '../previs/compositionConstraints';
