16:   solveShotToCompositionConstraints as solveShotToCompositionConstraintsEngine,
17:   type CompositionConstraintSolveOptions,
18: } from '../previs/compositionConstraintSolver';
19: import { agentError, writeAccessRequiredDiagnostic, type AgentDiagnostic } from './diagnostics';
20: import type {
21:   AgentShotCompositionInspection,
22:   AgentShotCompositionMutationResult,
23: } from './protocol';
24: 
25: function mapDiagnostic(item: CompositionConstraintDiagnostic): AgentDiagnostic {
26:   return agentError(item.code, item.message, {
27:     path: item.entityId ? `shotComposition.entities[id=${item.entityId}]` : undefined,
28:   });
29: }
30: 
31: function mapInspection(result: ShotCompositionConstraintInspection): AgentShotCompositionInspection {
32:   return {
33:     ok: result.ok,
34:     shotId: result.shotId,
35:     contractPresent: result.contractPresent,
36:     totalWeightedError: result.totalWeightedError,
37:     entities: structuredClone(result.entities),
38:     diagnostics: result.diagnostics.map(mapDiagnostic),
39:   };
40: }
41: 
42: function shotOrFailure(project: LocationProject, shotId: string) {
43:   const shot = project.shots.find((candidate) => candidate.id === shotId);
44:   if (!shot) {
45:     return {
46:       shot: undefined,
47:       diagnostics: [agentError('shot_not_found', `No shot with id "${shotId}".`)],
48:     };
49:   }
50:   return { shot, diagnostics: [] as AgentDiagnostic[] };
51: }
52: 
53: function isUnitInterval(value: number | undefined): boolean {
54:   return value === undefined || (Number.isFinite(value) && value >= 0 && value <= 1);
55: }
56: 
57: function validateRect(value: unknown, label: string): AgentDiagnostic | undefined {
58:   if (value === undefined) return undefined;
59:   if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') return agentError('invalid_argument', `${label} must be a normalized rectangle.`);
60:   const rect = value as Record<string, unknown>;
61:   if (![rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height].every((item) => typeof item === 'number' && Number.isFinite(item))) {
62:     return agentError('invalid_argument', `${label} must contain finite x, y, width, and height values.`);
63:   }
64:   if (![rect.x, rect.y, rect.width, rect.height].every((item) => (item as number) >= 0 && (item as number) <= 1)) {
65:     return agentError('invalid_argument', `${label} must use normalized values in the 0–1 range.`);
66:   }
67:   return undefined;
68: }
69: 
70: function validateConstraintInput(contract: ShotCompositionConstraintSet): AgentDiagnostic | undefined {
71:   if (!contract || !Array.isArray(contract.subjects)) {
72:     return agentError('invalid_argument', 'A composition contract requires a subjects array.');
73:   }
74:   for (const [index, subject] of contract.subjects.entries()) {
75:     if (!subject?.entityId?.trim()) return agentError('invalid_argument', `subjects[${index}].entityId is required.`);
76:     const rectError = validateRect(subject.expectedBounds, `subjects[${index}].expectedBounds`);
77:     if (rectError) return rectError;
78:     if (![subject.headPoint, subject.facePoint].every((point) => (
79:       point === undefined
80:       || (Array.isArray(point) && point.length === 2 && point.every((item) => isUnitInterval(item)))
81:     ))) {
82:       return agentError('invalid_argument', `subjects[${index}] points must be normalized [x, y] values.`);
83:     }
84:     if (!isUnitInterval(subject.expectedVisibility)) {
85:       return agentError('invalid_argument', `subjects[${index}].expectedVisibility must be in the 0–1 range.`);
86:     }
87:   }
88:   for (const [index, prop] of (contract.props ?? []).entries()) {
89:     if (!prop?.entityId?.trim()) return agentError('invalid_argument', `props[${index}].entityId is required.`);
90:     const rectError = validateRect(prop.expectedBounds, `props[${index}].expectedBounds`);
91:     if (rectError) return rectError;
92:     if (prop.expectedScreenPoint && !(
93:       Array.isArray(prop.expectedScreenPoint)
94:       && prop.expectedScreenPoint.length === 2
95:       && prop.expectedScreenPoint.every((item) => isUnitInterval(item))
96:     )) {
97:       return agentError('invalid_argument', `props[${index}].expectedScreenPoint must be normalized [x, y].`);
98:     }
99:   }
100:   if (!isUnitInterval(contract.horizonY) || !isUnitInterval(contract.floorLineY)) {
101:     return agentError('invalid_argument', 'horizonY and floorLineY must be normalized values in the 0–1 range.');
102:   }
103:   if (contract.cropTolerance !== undefined && (!Number.isFinite(contract.cropTolerance) || contract.cropTolerance < 0)) {
104:     return agentError('invalid_argument', 'cropTolerance must be a finite non-negative number.');
105:   }
106:   return undefined;
107: }
108: 
109: function cloneProduction(project: LocationProject) {
110:   const existing = project.workflow.production;
111:   if (existing) return structuredClone(existing);
112:   const legacyBindings = project.workflow.productionManifestAssetBindings ?? {};
113:   return {
114:     schemaVersion: 1 as const,
115:     bindings: Object.fromEntries(
116:       Object.entries(legacyBindings).map(([entityId, objectId]) => [entityId, { kind: 'object' as const, objectId }]),
117:     ),
118:     locations: {},
119:     shotContracts: {},
120:   };
121: }
122: 
123: async function persistCompositionMutation(
124:   operation: string,
125:   mutate: (project: LocationProject) => LocationProject,
126: ): Promise<AgentShotCompositionMutationResult> {
127:   if (useAgentControlStore.getState().controlMode !== 'read-write') {
128:     return { ok: false, diagnostics: [writeAccessRequiredDiagnostic(operation)] };
129:   }
130:   const runDestructive = useProjectSafetyStore.getState().runDestructiveProjectMutation;
131:   if (!runDestructive) {
132:     return { ok: false, diagnostics: [agentError('persistence_not_ready', 'Project persistence is not ready.')] };
133:   }
134:   try {
135:     const verified = await runDestructive(operation, () => {
136:       useProjectStore.setState((state) => ({ project: touchProject(mutate(state.project)) }));
137:     });
138:     return { ok: true, revisionId: verified?.revision.id, diagnostics: [] };
139:   } catch (error) {
140:     return {
141:       ok: false,
142:       diagnostics: [agentError(
143:         'composition_mutation_failed',
144:         error instanceof Error ? error.message : `${operation} failed.`,
145:       )],
146:     };
147:   }
148: }
149: 
150: export function inspectAgentShotCompositionError(input: { shotId: string }): AgentShotCompositionInspection {
151:   const project = useProjectStore.getState().project;
152:   const target = shotOrFailure(project, input.shotId);
153:   if (!target.shot) {
154:     return {
155:       ok: false,
156:       shotId: input.shotId,
157:       contractPresent: false,
158:       totalWeightedError: 0,
159:       entities: {},
160:       diagnostics: target.diagnostics,
161:     };
162:   }
163:   return mapInspection(inspectShotCompositionErrorEngine(project, target.shot));
164: }
165: 
166: export function verifyAgentShotCompositionConstraints(input: { shotId: string }): AgentShotCompositionInspection {
167:   const project = useProjectStore.getState().project;
168:   const target = shotOrFailure(project, input.shotId);
169:   if (!target.shot) return inspectAgentShotCompositionError(input);
170:   return mapInspection(verifyShotCompositionConstraintsEngine(project, target.shot));
171: }
172: 
173: export async function setAgentShotCompositionConstraints(input: {
174:   shotId: string;
175:   contract: ShotCompositionConstraintSet;
176: }): Promise<AgentShotCompositionMutationResult> {
177:   const project = useProjectStore.getState().project;
178:   const target = shotOrFailure(project, input.shotId);
179:   if (!target.shot) return { ok: false, diagnostics: target.diagnostics };
180:   const invalid = validateConstraintInput(input.contract);
181:   if (invalid) return { ok: false, diagnostics: [invalid] };
182:   return persistCompositionMutation('Set shot composition constraints', (current) => {
183:     const production = cloneProduction(current);
184:     production.shotContracts[input.shotId] = {
185:       ...(production.shotContracts[input.shotId] ?? {}),
186:       composition: structuredClone(input.contract),
187:     };
188:     return {
189:       ...current,
190:       schemaVersion: '1.2',
191:       workflow: { ...current.workflow, production },
192:     };
193:   });
194: }
195: 
196: export async function solveAgentShotToCompositionConstraints(input: {
197:   shotId: string;
198:   maxIterations?: number;
199: }): Promise<AgentShotCompositionMutationResult> {
200:   const project = useProjectStore.getState().project;
201:   const target = shotOrFailure(project, input.shotId);
202:   if (!target.shot) return { ok: false, diagnostics: target.diagnostics };
203:   const contract = getShotCompositionContract(project, target.shot);
204:   if (!contract) {
205:     return {
206:       ok: false,
207:       diagnostics: [agentError('composition_contract_missing', `Shot "${input.shotId}" has no composition contract.`)],
208:     };
209:   }
210:   const options: CompositionConstraintSolveOptions = input.maxIterations === undefined
211:     ? {}
212:     : { maxIterations: input.maxIterations };
213:   const solved = solveShotToCompositionConstraintsEngine(project, target.shot, contract, options);
214:   const before = mapInspection(solved.before);
215:   const after = mapInspection(solved.after);
216:   if (!solved.ok) {
217:     return {
218:       ok: false,
219:       status: 'failed',
220:       changed: false,
221:       iterations: solved.iterations,
222:       before,
223:       after,
224:       diagnostics: solved.diagnostics.map(mapDiagnostic),
225:     };
226:   }
227:   const mutation = await persistCompositionMutation('Solve shot composition constraints', (current) => ({
228:     ...current,
229:     shots: current.shots.map((shot) => shot.id === input.shotId
230:       ? { ...shot, camera: structuredClone(solved.shot.camera) }
231:       : shot),
232:   }));
233:   if (!mutation.ok) return { ...mutation, before, after, changed: false, iterations: solved.iterations };
234:   const live = useProjectStore.getState().project;
235:   const liveShot = live.shots.find((shot) => shot.id === input.shotId);
236:   const verified = liveShot
237:     ? mapInspection(verifyShotCompositionConstraintsEngine(live, liveShot, contract))
238:     : after;
239:   const verificationOk = verified.ok;
240:   return {
241:     ...mutation,
242:     ok: verificationOk,
243:     status: verificationOk ? 'completed' : 'failed',
244:     changed: solved.changed,
245:     iterations: solved.iterations,
246:     before,
247:     after: verified,
248:     diagnostics: verificationOk ? [] : verified.diagnostics,
249:   };
250: }

80:     point[index] = nextValue;

91:     || a.target.some((value, index) => value !== b.target[index]);

105: /**
106:  * Refine only camera position, target, and FOV. Subject identity, pose,
107:  * location, panorama, and continuity state are intentionally immutable here.
108:  */
109: export function solveShotToCompositionConstraints(
110:   project: LocationProject,
111:   shotInput: Shot | string,
112:   contract?: ShotCompositionConstraintSet,
113:   options: CompositionConstraintSolveOptions = {},
114: ): CompositionConstraintSolveResult {
115:   const resolvedShot = typeof shotInput === 'string'
116:     ? project.shots.find((shot) => shot.id === shotInput)
117:     : shotInput;
118:   const shotId = typeof shotInput === 'string' ? shotInput : shotInput.id;
119:   if (!resolvedShot) {
120:     const before = inspectShotCompositionError(project, shotId, contract);
121:     return {
122:       ok: false,
123:       shotId,
124:       before,
125:       after: before,
126:       shot: shotInput as Shot,
127:       changed: false,
128:       iterations: 0,
129:       diagnostics: before.diagnostics,
130:     };
131:   }
132: 
133:   const config = { ...DEFAULT_OPTIONS, ...options };
134:   const before = inspectShotCompositionError(project, resolvedShot, contract);
135:   const startCamera = cloneCamera(resolvedShot.camera);
136:   let current = inspectCandidate(project, resolvedShot, startCamera, contract);
137:   let iterations = 0;
138: 
139:   // Coarse-to-fine coordinate descent. The fixed order and fixed deltas make
140:   // the result reproducible across browser and CLI adapters.
141:   const passes: Array<{ axis: 'position' | 'target' | 'fov'; index: number; deltas: number[] }> = [
142:     { axis: 'target', index: 0, deltas: [-0.5, 0.5, -0.2, 0.2, -0.05, 0.05] },
143:     { axis: 'target', index: 1, deltas: [-0.4, 0.4, -0.15, 0.15, -0.05, 0.05] },
144:     { axis: 'target', index: 2, deltas: [-0.5, 0.5, -0.2, 0.2, -0.05, 0.05] },
145:     { axis: 'position', index: 0, deltas: [-0.5, 0.5, -0.2, 0.2, -0.05, 0.05] },
146:     { axis: 'position', index: 1, deltas: [-0.3, 0.3, -0.1, 0.1, -0.03, 0.03] },
147:     { axis: 'position', index: 2, deltas: [-0.5, 0.5, -0.2, 0.2, -0.05, 0.05] },
148:     { axis: 'fov', index: 0, deltas: [-8, 8, -3, 3, -1, 1] },
149:   ];
150: 
151:   for (let pass = 0; pass < config.maxIterations; pass += 1) {
152:     iterations += 1;
153:     const passStartObjective = current.objective;
154:     for (const step of passes) {
155:       let best = current;
156:       for (const delta of step.deltas) {
157:         const camera = candidateCamera(startCamera, current.camera, step.axis, step.index, delta, config);
158:         if (!camera) continue;
159:         const candidate = inspectCandidate(project, resolvedShot, camera, contract);
160:         if (candidate.objective + config.minimumImprovement < best.objective) best = candidate;
161:       }
162:       current = best;
163:     }
164:     if (passStartObjective - current.objective < config.minimumImprovement) break;
165:   }
166: 
167:   const solvedShot: Shot = { ...resolvedShot, camera: current.camera };
168:   const after = current.inspection;
169:   return {
170:     ok: after.contractPresent && after.diagnostics.length === 0,
171:     shotId,
172:     before,
173:     after,
174:     shot: solvedShot,
175:     changed: cameraChanged(startCamera, current.camera),
176:     iterations,
177:     diagnostics: after.diagnostics,
178:   };
